rblms.require(['jquery'], function($ ) {
	$(".expand-headline").click(function(){
         $(this).parent('div').toggleClass("expand");
        $(this).parent('div').find(".expand-collapse__item").slideToggle();
    });
   
// Hide Header on on scroll down
var didScroll;
var lastScrollTop = 0;
var delta = 100;
var navbarHeight = $('header').outerHeight();

$(window).scroll(function(event){
    didScroll = true;
});

setInterval(function() {
    if (didScroll) {
        hasScrolled();
        didScroll = false;
    }
}, 250);

function hasScrolled() {
    var st = $(this).scrollTop();
    
    // Make sure they scroll more than delta
    if(Math.abs(lastScrollTop - st) <= delta)
        return;
    
    // If they scrolled down and are past the navbar, add class .nav-up.
    // This is necessary so you never see what is "behind" the navbar.
    if (st > lastScrollTop && st > navbarHeight){
        // Scroll Down
        $('.rebelbar.rebelbar--fixed').removeClass('nav-down').addClass('nav-up');
    } else {
        // Scroll Up
        if(st + $(window).height() < $(document).height()) {
            $('.rebelbar.rebelbar--fixed').removeClass('nav-up').addClass('nav-down');
        }
    }
    
    lastScrollTop = st;
}
});

/*! getClosest.js | (c) 2017 Chris Ferdinandi | MIT License | http://github.com/cferdinandi/getClosest */
/**
 * Get the closest parent element that matches a selector. 
 * @param  {Element} elem     Starting element
 * @param  {String}  selector Selector to match against
 * @return {Boolean|Element}  Returns null if not match found
 */
var getClosest = function ( elem, selector ) {

    // Element.matches() polyfill
    if (!Element.prototype.matches) {
        Element.prototype.matches =
            Element.prototype.matchesSelector ||
            Element.prototype.mozMatchesSelector ||
            Element.prototype.msMatchesSelector ||
            Element.prototype.oMatchesSelector ||
            Element.prototype.webkitMatchesSelector ||
            function(s) {
                var matches = (this.document || this.ownerDocument).querySelectorAll(s),
                    i = matches.length;
                while (--i >= 0 && matches.item(i) !== this) {}
                return i > -1;
            };
    }

    // Get closest match
    for ( ; elem && elem !== document; elem = elem.parentNode ) {
        if ( elem.matches( selector ) ) return elem;
    }

    return null;

};

<h1 class="widget__headline h1">
<a aria-label="Katie Hill Was In The Closet Making Babies And I Saw One Of The Babies And The Baby Looked At Me!" class="widget__headline-text custom-post-headline" href="https://www.wonkette.com/katie-hill-had-sex-destroyed-country-somehow">
    Katie Hill Was In The Closet Making Babies And I Saw One Of The Babies And The Baby Looked At Me!
</a></h1>
<div class="social-author clearfix">
<div class="social-author__avatar image">
<div class="cover-all image" style='background-image: url("https://assets.rbl.ms/18111476/210x.jpg")'></div>
</div>
<a class="social-author__name" href="https://www.wonkette.com/u/stephenrobinson">Stephen Robinson</a>
</div>
<div class="social-date">
<span class="social-date__text">October 25, 2019 01:05 PM</span>
</div>
<div class="body js-expandable clearfix js-listicle-body css-listicle-body-2641102282">
<div class="body-description"><div class="widget__brief"><p>Democrat Katie Hill is a freshman House member who flipped a California district that Republicans had held since 1993. Hill is a rising star, or rather she was. She's now the subject of a House ethics probe over a matter I don't think is anyone's business. Hill <a href="https://www.cnbc.com/2019/10/24/rep-katie-hill-admits-to-having-an-inappropriate-relationship-with-a-staffer.html" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">confirmed</a> that she had an "inappropriate relationship" with a female campaign staffer. However, she's denied an affair with her legislative director, Graham Kelly, who is a current member of her office staff.</p><p>House rules forbid a "sexual relationship with any employee of the House who works under the supervision of the Member, Delegate, or Resident Commissioner." It's a new rule the House implemented last year in response to longstanding allegations of sexual misconduct, specifically involving Michigan <a href="https://www.latimes.com/nation/ct-house-prohibits-relationships-20180206-story.html" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Rep. John Conyers.</a> But unlike Brutus, Conyers was not an honorable man. He was Dabney Coleman in <em><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WPQRMeU4Co0" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">9 to 5,</a></em> a gross lech who repeatedly made unwanted sexual advances to female staffers and <a href="https://www.buzzfeednews.com/article/paulmcleod/she-complained-that-a-powerful-congressman-harassed-her#.dyqANaD2D" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">reportedly</a> retaliated against those who resisted. </p><p>Consensual sex is both natural and fun, but nonconsensual sex isn't a great pop song. I don't understand how we conflated the two. <em>My personal opinion</em> is that office romances are a bad idea but they're not inherently unethical or criminal. Yes, there are oppressive workplace environments where (mostly) women aren't empowered to say "no" to their supervisors. Brooke Nevils legitimately believed her career was at risk if she didn't continue a sexual relationship with former "Today" show host <a href="https://www.wonkette.com/matt-lauer-even-more-of-gross-rapist-asshole-than-we-thought" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Matt Lauer,</a> who she says raped her. Vanina Guerrero recently charged that Louis Lehot, co-managing partner at DLA Piper, assaulted her multiple times. He lied about the nature of their "relationship" and actively sabotaged her professionally. <a href="https://www.wonkette.com/frottage-perv-mark-halperin-demands-his-second-act-at-lousy-punditry" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Mark Halperin</a> and <a href="https://www.wonkette.com/louis-ck-is-ready-for-his-redemption-arc-mr-demille" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Louis C.K.</a> masturbated in front of horrified women because that's something disgusting but powerful men like to do.</p></div>
<div class="js-appear-on-expand">
<script type="keep-reading-content">&lt;p class=&#34;shortcode-media shortcode-media-youtube&#34;&gt;
        &lt;span style=&#34;display:block;position:relative;padding-top:56.25%;&#34; class=&#34;rm-shortcode&#34; data-rm-shortcode-id=&#34;UAE5WU1572120896&#34;&gt;&lt;iframe lazy-loadable=&#34;true&#34; src=&#34;https://www.youtube.com/embed/cF6CN042WVs?rel=0&#34; width=&#34;100%&#34; height=&#34;auto&#34; frameborder=&#34;0&#34; scrolling=&#34;no&#34; style=&#34;position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;&#34;&gt;&lt;/iframe&gt;&lt;/span&gt;
        &lt;small class=&#34;image-media media-caption&#34; placeholder=&#34;Add Photo Caption...&#34;&gt;Katie Hill: Opponent won&#39;t love being unseated by a millennial&lt;/small&gt;
        &lt;small class=&#34;image-media media-photo-credit&#34; placeholder=&#34;Add Photo Credit...&#34;&gt;

        &lt;/small&gt;
        &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Hill is not like any of these men. I respect the opinion of those who believe sexual relationships with a subordinate are always wrong. And elected officials should have the will and ethical restraint to follow simple rules. But people make mistakes. Hill fooling around with a staffer during the fractious, final days of her marriage is a lapse in judgment. It should remain private. There&#39;s no evidence that she forced herself on the staffer or coerced her in any way. The relationship is just ... inappropriate, which seems like we&#39;re judging someone&#39;s personal choices without considering their actual impact on others. It just feels weird and regressive, like when you learn one of King Henry&#39;s wives was executed because she cheated on him.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;I&#39;m also wary of the argument that these relationships are wrong simply because society believes they&#39;re wrong so it makes a politician subject to blackmail because they&#39;re desperate to avoid exposure (whew!). This is the kind of circular logic that was used to discriminate against gay people in the not-so-good old days.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Even Republican Rep. &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/matt-gaetz-if-trump-did-thing-trump-confessed-to-thats-bad-but-trump-didnt-do-thing-trump-confessed-to-so&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Matt Gaetz&lt;/a&gt; agrees, which concerns me a little. But I guess this falls under the &#34;stopped clock&#34; principle.&lt;/p&gt;
        &lt;p class=&#34;shortcode-media shortcode-media-twitter_embed&#34;&gt;
        &lt;iframe width=&#34;100%&#34; height=&#34;150&#34; scrolling=&#34;no&#34; id=&#34;twitter-embed-1187338202266460165&#34; src=&#34;/res/community/twitter_embed/?iframe_id=twitter-embed-1187338202266460165&amp;created_ts=1571918461.0&amp;screen_name=mattgaetz&amp;text=This+is+just+absurd.+The+only+person+who+seems+to+have+a+gripe+is+%40RepKatieHill%E2%80%99s+soon-to-be+ex.+%0A%0AWho+among+us+wou%E2%80%A6+https%3A%2F%2Ft.co%2FaugRT71bCT&amp;id=1187338202266460165&amp;name=Matt+Gaetz&#34; frameborder=&#34;0&#34; class=&#34;rm-shortcode&#34; data-rm-shortcode-id=&#34;G7IIO01572034472&#34;&gt;&lt;/iframe&gt;
        &lt;/p&gt;
        &lt;p&gt;Hill&#39;s troubles began this weekend when Red State published a series of articles accusing Hill of an affair with her unnamed staff member and Kelly. It also ran a nude photo of Hill -- a gross violation of her privacy. Red State isn&#39;t a common &lt;em&gt;Penthouse&lt;/em&gt; magazine, which printed nude photos of &lt;a href=&#34;https://time.com/3961120/miss-america-scandal-vanessa-williams/&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Vanessa Williams&lt;/a&gt; in 1984. &lt;em&gt;Penthouse&lt;/em&gt; just wanted to cash in on the first black Miss America&#39;s sudden fame and didn&#39;t care if her life was ruined in the process. (Williams &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p1rJAFNFVEc&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;bounced the fuck back,&lt;/a&gt; by the way.) Red State is a publication with the journalistic ethics of a Peeping Tom that likes aiming wrecking balls at Democrats. Red State even ran some followup articles (nope, not linking them) expressing its annoyance that legitimate media hadn&#39;t hopped on the Katie Hill Smear Campaign bandwagon.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;The &lt;em&gt;Daily Mail,&lt;/em&gt; unfortunately, did jump on with all eight feet like a common &lt;em&gt;Hustler&lt;/em&gt;. The &lt;em&gt;Mail&lt;/em&gt; identified the female staffer without (as far as we know) her consent, which was gross and served no public good. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class=&#34;shortcode-media shortcode-media-rebelmouse-image&#34;&gt;
        &lt;img lazy-loadable=&#34;true&#34; src=&#34;https://assets.rebelmouse.io/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpbWFnZSI6Imh0dHBzOi8vYXNzZXRzLnJibC5tcy8yMjAzMTY2Ny9vcmlnaW4ucG5nIiwiZXhwaXJlc19hdCI6MTU3MjU2NzU4N30.61ToG6KiB1YGbEV0276zZGqYa5mNa7suLhDVCCcAhqc/img.png?width=980&#34; id=&#34;098f0&#34; class=&#34;rm-shortcode&#34; data-rm-shortcode-id=&#34;9CU7RC1572120896&#34; data-rm-shortcode-name=&#34;rebelmouse-image&#34;   /&gt;
        
        
        &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;What&#39;s &#34;shocking&#34; is that the &lt;em&gt;Mail&lt;/em&gt; would print someone&#39;s personal photos -- amateurishly obscuring the &#34;naughty bits&#34; with what looks like a Sharpie. Monica Lewinsky&#39;s life was steamrolled in 1998 but she was a witness in an independent counsel investigation. There&#39;s no reason to think that the female staffer would ever have to come forward publicly. Lewinksy also turned over the infamous dress. The staffer did not turn over these pictures. It&#39;s also not clear that Hill&#39;s tattoo is of the Iron Cross, and I&#39;ve already examined it longer than my wedding vows permit. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;The likely source for Hill&#39;s personal text messages and nude photos isn&#39;t anyone who works for her but probably her soon-to-be ex husband, who Hill claims was &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.refinery29.com/en-us/2019/10/8618541/katie-hill-revenge-porn-nude-photos-leaked-congress&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;&#34;abusive.&#34;&lt;/a&gt;  Years ago, an employee&#39;s jilted ex came to the office to personally tell me what he believed was incriminating information about her. There&#39;s nothing worse than trying to destroy a woman because she wants nothing more to do with your sorry ass. (I had a sudden bout of amnesia that day so immediately forgot everything the asshole told me.)&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Hill is standing firm and cooperating with the ethics investigation. She&#39;s apologized to her constituents in a public statement:&lt;/p&gt;&lt;blockquote&gt;&#34;During the final tumultuous years of my abusive marriage, I became involved in a relationship with someone on my campaign. I know that even a consensual relationship with a subordinate is inappropriate, but I still allowed it to happen despite my better judgment. For that I apologize. I wish nothing but the best for her and hope everyone respects her privacy in this difficult time.&#34;&lt;/blockquote&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;a href=&#34;https://www.nytimes.com/2019/10/22/us/politics/katie-hill-relationship.html&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Reportedly,&lt;/a&gt; some male Democrats privately believe Hill is the beneficiary of a double standard -- like all those lucky ducky women in the working world. They think a man in Hill&#39;s situation would&#39;ve immediately resigned by now. They must have trouble comprehending consent. Rep. &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.politico.com/story/2017/10/05/tim-murphy-abortion-scandal-office-staffers-243521&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Tim Murphy&lt;/a&gt; resigned in 2017 because he was outed as a creep who abused his staff. Rep. Joe Barton sent &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.thedailybeast.com/gop-rep-joe-barton-apologizes-after-graphic-photo-circulates-online&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;unsolicited&lt;/a&gt; dick picks. &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/rep-trent-franks-of-arizona-is-expected-to-resign/2017/12/07/479d156a-db9f-11e7-b859-fb0995360725_story.html&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Rep. Trent Franks&lt;/a&gt; asked female employees if they&#39;d consider bearing his children. Katie Hill had an affair. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Ideally, we would create workplace cultures where employees are free to report sexual misconduct without fear. But I don&#39;t think the solution is to remove employees&#39; freedom to choose their sexual partners. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;[&lt;a href=&#34;https://www.cnbc.com/2019/10/24/rep-katie-hill-admits-to-having-an-inappropriate-relationship-with-a-staffer.html&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;CNBC&lt;/a&gt;]&lt;br/&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Follow Stephen Robinson on &lt;/em&gt;&lt;em&gt;&lt;a href=&#34;https://twitter.com/SER1897&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Twitter.&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/em&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Yr Wonkette is supported by reader donations. Please send us money to keep the writers paid and the servers humming. <h1 class="widget__headline h1">
<a aria-label="This Is Not America" class="widget__headline-text custom-post-headline" href="https://www.wonkette.com/this-is-not-america">
    This Is Not America
</a></h1>
<div class="social-author clearfix">
<div class="social-author__avatar image">
<div class="cover-all image" style='background-image: url("https://assets.rbl.ms/18110596/210x.jpg")'></div>
</div>
<a class="social-author__name" href="https://www.wonkette.com/u/evan_hurst">Evan Hurst</a>
</div>
<div class="social-date">
<span class="social-date__text">October 25, 2019 12:33 PM</span>
</div>
<div class="body js-expandable clearfix js-listicle-body css-listicle-body-2641101862">
<div class="body-description"><div class="widget__brief"><p>The <em>New York Times</em> <a href="https://www.nytimes.com/2019/10/24/us/politics/john-durham-criminal-investigation.html" target="_blank">reported</a> Thursday night that Attorney General Bill Barr's <a href="https://www.wonkette.com/everything-you-never-wanted-to-know-about-bill-barrs-totally-real-global-carmen-sandiego-on-bath-salts-adventures" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">jaunt around the globe</a> to chase down every weird conspiracy theory about the origins of the Russia investigation that falls out of Donald Trump's ass is now a <em>criminal</em> investigation, which means John Durham, the US attorney ostensibly leading the investigation, now has power to impanel a grand jury, issue subpoenas, and yes, bring criminal charges.</p><p>Against people who investigated Russia's attack on the 2016 election that helped install Donald Trump in office. </p><p>If this news is what it seems like it is, then America is on thin ice. This is Kremlin shithole banana republic stuff, which shouldn't surprise us, because a Kremlin shithole banana republic guy is president of the United States.</p><p>So is Trump just going after his political enemies and using the strong arm of the Justice Department, led by Bill Barr, his low-rent frumpy Roy Cohn stand-in, to do it? Well, it would appear that way, wouldn't it! Think about it. Trump literally thinks the men and women who have conducted these investigations have committed <em>treason</em>.</p></div>
<div class="js-appear-on-expand">
<script type="keep-reading-content">&lt;p&gt;&lt;span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;Ever since the beginning of Trump&#39;s presidency, he has done everything he can to turn into Public Enemy No. 1 every single person involved with investigating whether or not he or his campaign conspired with our adversary Russia in its to project to steal an American election. He fired FBI Director James Comey. He&#39;s &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/strzok-strikes-back&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;led insane Twitter campaigns&lt;/a&gt; against Peter Strzok and Lisa Page, two FBI officials who were not only extra-maritally fucking, but who also are known for being experts in going after &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/peter-strzok-testimony-live-updates&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Russian spies&lt;/a&gt; and &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/lets-throw-a-bunch-of-sh-t-at-the-wall-and-call-it-the-trump-russia-smokinggun&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Russian organized crime,&lt;/a&gt; respectively. (Page&#39;s team in Budapest helped put together the bribery case against Ukrainian oligarch and alleged frontman for the Russian mob Dmitry Firtash, who is &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/rudy-giuliani-says-he-never-met-ukrainian-oligarch-dmitry-firtash-and-you-can-take-that-to-the-bank&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;suddenly a star&lt;/a&gt; of the Trump-Ukraine scandal, as he seemingly tried to trade fake dirt on Joe Biden for the Justice Department&#39;s help with the case the Chicago feds brought against him. Weird, right?)&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Another one of Trump&#39;s &lt;em&gt;bêtes noires&lt;/em&gt; is Bruce Ohr, who, big surprise, &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/who-the-fuck-is-bruce-ohr-a-wonksplanation-of-who-the-fuck-that-guy-is&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;is an expert&lt;/a&gt; on Russian organized crime and the Russian mob.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;And that&#39;s just scratching the surface of Americans Donald Trump despises. (We haven&#39;t mentioned Andrew McCabe, whom Trump and his Justice Department &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/justice-department-will-get-andy-mccabe-or-die-tryin&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;have been targeting&lt;/a&gt; for ages. Mentioning him right now!) &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Before last night&#39;s news, it had been reported that what began as a simple review has &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/justice-department/ag-barr-expands-controversial-review-origin-russia-investigation-n1068971&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;significantly expanded&lt;/a&gt; lately, with Durham&#39;s team wanting to interview former CIA director John Brennan (one of Trump&#39;s perceived biggest threats, with whom &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.politico.com/news/2019/10/22/trump-vengeance-john-brennan-russia-053970&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;he is &lt;em&gt;obsessed&lt;/em&gt;&lt;/a&gt; to the point he &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/aunt-lydia-announces-john-brennan-shall-be-punished&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;tried to take&lt;/a&gt; Brennan&#39;s security clearance away) and former director of national intelligence James Clapper (Trump hates him too). NBC News reported Durham&#39;s also been wanting to talk to CIA people &#34;involved in the intelligence assessment of Russia&#39;s activities,&#34; we guess just to find out if they&#39;ve been framing Russia this whole time like Donald Trump obviously believes. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&#34;All roads lead to Putin,&#34; just like &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/nancy-pelosi-blesses-trumps-heart-after-presidents-brain-leaks-all-over-white-house-floor-again&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Nancy Pelosi said.&lt;/a&gt; &lt;/p&gt;&lt;h2&gt;So What Supposedly &#39;Criminal&#39; Acts Might Barr And Durham Be Investigating?&lt;/h2&gt;&lt;p&gt;LOL who fuckin&#39; knows. We doubt Bill Barr or John Durham even knows. Quick, guys, make something up! <h1 class="widget__headline h1">
<a aria-label="Let's Sit Quietly Together And Witness Elijah Cummings's Funeral" class="widget__headline-text custom-post-headline" href="https://www.wonkette.com/elijah-cummings-funeral">
    Let's Sit Quietly Together And Witness Elijah Cummings's Funeral
</a></h1>
<div class="social-author clearfix">
<div class="social-author__avatar image">
<div class="cover-all image" style='background-image: url("https://assets.rbl.ms/18110113/210x.jpg")'></div>
</div>
<a class="social-author__name" href="https://www.wonkette.com/u/doktor_zoom">Doktor Zoom</a>
</div>
<div class="social-date">
<span class="social-date__text">October 25, 2019 09:47 AM</span>
</div>
<div class="body js-expandable clearfix js-listicle-body css-listicle-body-2641100319">
<div class="body-description"><div class="widget__brief"><p>The funeral for Elijah Cummings will be held today at the church he attended, Baltimore's New Psalmist Baptist Church, starting at 10:00 Eastern. The <a href="https://www.baltimoresun.com/politics/bs-md-pol-obama-cummings-funeral-20191024-h7n2yqflnjcfpl6dbl6lfx3g2u-story.html" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">speakers </a>will include Barack Obama, Bill and Hillary Clinton, Nancy Pelosi, and former congressman Kweisi Mfume, whose seat Cummings won in 1996 when Mfume became president of the NAACP. Cummings's widow, Maya Rockeymoore Cummings, will also speak; she's the chair of the Maryland Democratic Party. </p><p>Yr Wonkette has the Washington Post's livestream below; you can also view the services <a href="https://www.c-span.org/video/?465670-1/representative-elijah-cummings-funeral-baltimore" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">at CSPAN</a> starting at 10. </p></div>
<div class="js-appear-on-expand">
<script type="keep-reading-content">&lt;p&gt;&lt;br/&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class=&#34;shortcode-media shortcode-media-youtube&#34;&gt;
        &lt;span style=&#34;display:block;position:relative;padding-top:56.25%;&#34; class=&#34;rm-shortcode&#34; data-rm-shortcode-id=&#34;QMZTKC1572112224&#34;&gt;&lt;iframe lazy-loadable=&#34;true&#34; src=&#34;https://www.youtube.com/embed/5W-74Hp3GzE?rel=0&#34; width=&#34;100%&#34; height=&#34;auto&#34; frameborder=&#34;0&#34; scrolling=&#34;no&#34; style=&#34;position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;&#34;&gt;&lt;/iframe&gt;&lt;/span&gt;
        &lt;small class=&#34;image-media media-caption&#34; placeholder=&#34;Add Photo Caption...&#34;&gt;Watch live 10:00 a.m.: Rep. Elijah Cummings to be honored by Obama, Clinton at funeral&lt;/small&gt;
        &lt;small class=&#34;image-media media-photo-credit&#34; placeholder=&#34;Add Photo Credit...&#34;&gt;
            &lt;a href=&#34;https://youtu.be/5W-74Hp3GzE&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;youtu.be&lt;/a&gt;
        &lt;/small&gt;
        &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;br/&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Cummings, a fighter&lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/elijah-cummings-1951-2019&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt; for civil rights and basic decency,&lt;/a&gt; died last Thursday in hospice care in Baltimore, at the age of 68. He hadn&#39;t been in Congress for a roll call vote since September, but continued with committee work right up until the end, &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/cummings-goes-out-swinging&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;sending out subpoenas&lt;/a&gt; just hours before he passed away. &lt;br/&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Elijah Cummings&#39;s prominence as an opponent of Donald Trump&#39;s racism, inhuman border policies, and abuses of office made him a target for abuse by the &#34;president&#34; and his online troll army. Expect the Usual Suspects to pretend they&#39;re shocked and horrified by any statements at the memorial that might be deemed to &#34;politicize&#34; the services for a man who used political office to do good. There&#39;s already been some tut-tutting (and some &lt;em&gt;very unseemly&lt;/em&gt; celebration) of a pallbearer&#39;s passing over Mitch McConnell and Kevin McCarthy while shaking hands with lawmakers at the Capitol yesterday. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class=&#34;shortcode-media shortcode-media-twitter_embed&#34;&gt;
        &lt;iframe width=&#34;100%&#34; height=&#34;150&#34; scrolling=&#34;no&#34; id=&#34;twitter-embed-1187403541113126915&#34; src=&#34;/res/community/twitter_embed/?iframe_id=twitter-embed-1187403541113126915&amp;created_ts=1571934039.0&amp;screen_name=akajd31&amp;text=I+think+this+brother+right+here+walked+right+past+McConnell+and+did+NOT+shake+his+hand%21%21%21++Wow%21++%40DrJasonJohnson%E2%80%A6+https%3A%2F%2Ft.co%2F56f5zOvDrp&amp;id=1187403541113126915&amp;name=Moni+jay&#34; frameborder=&#34;0&#34; class=&#34;rm-shortcode&#34; data-rm-shortcode-id=&#34;7D8UO41572025560&#34;&gt;&lt;/iframe&gt;
        &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;For our money, there&#39;s no better discussion of the rampant bad faith in condemning &#34;politics&#34; at a politician&#39;s memorial than the chapter on the 2002 celebration of Sen. Paul Wellstone&#39;s life, in Al Franken&#39;s book &lt;a href=&#34;https://amzn.to/2Phm36E&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Lies: And the Lying Liars who Tell Them&lt;/a&gt;.  (A 2001 recap by Franken &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.huffpost.com/entry/reflections-on-the-wellst_b_15459&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;can be found here&lt;/a&gt;). Minnesotans loved Wellstone, and a couple of speakers at the memorial went beyond remembering his dedication to fighting the good fight, calling on Minnesotans to win the upcoming election &#34;for Paul.&#34; Some people in the crowd -- not the entire stadium -- booed Republican Trent Lott. But that was enough for very sensitive folks on the right, like etiquette expert Rush Limbaugh who hadn&#39;t actually watched the event, to gripe that the service had been &lt;em&gt;undignified&lt;/em&gt; and a &lt;em&gt;great shame,&lt;/em&gt; and then to start lying endlessly about how the entire service was a political rally with a &#34;planted&#34; partisan crowd, where those terrible liberals trashed George Bush and America all day.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Update: &lt;/strong&gt;As it happens, today is the anniversary of the plane crash that killed Wellstone, his wife Shiela, and their daughter Marcia, as well as the two pilots and two of Wellstone&#39;s campaign aides. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class=&#34;shortcode-media shortcode-media-twitter_embed&#34;&gt;
        &lt;iframe width=&#34;100%&#34; height=&#34;150&#34; scrolling=&#34;no&#34; id=&#34;twitter-embed-1187716092120256513&#34; src=&#34;/res/community/twitter_embed/?iframe_id=twitter-embed-1187716092120256513&amp;created_ts=1572008557.0&amp;screen_name=amyklobuchar&amp;text=Today+marks+17+years+since+we+tragically+lost+Paul+Wellstone%2C+his+wife+Sheila%2C+daughter+Marcia%2C+and+staff+Tom%2C+Mary%E2%80%A6+https%3A%2F%2Ft.co%2FQIj318DaSf&amp;id=1187716092120256513&amp;name=Amy+Klobuchar&#34; frameborder=&#34;0&#34; class=&#34;rm-shortcode&#34; data-rm-shortcode-id=&#34;JBDR8C1572025561&#34;&gt;&lt;/iframe&gt;
        &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Today&#39;s memorial will be in a church, not a football stadium, but the rightwing Civility Police have become ever more watchful, and we don&#39;t doubt for a moment that if any of the speakers so much as mentions anything &#34;political,&#34; however obliquely, the sound of pearls being clutched will be deafening. What if Barack Obama mentions his own family, like the narcissist he is? Or if Hillary Clinton talks too sharply about Cummings&#39;s basic decency? Surely that would be a slur on the current &#34;president!&#34;&lt;br/&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Good lord, what if someone at a funeral for a champion of civil rights mentions&lt;em&gt; race? &lt;/em&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Even if nothing objectionable is said, we don&#39;t doubt someone will take offense that all the speakers were Democrats. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;But look at us, getting &#34;political&#34; at such a somber time. Elijah Cummings was a brilliant man, a passionate believer in the power of politics to do good, and he certainly won&#39;t mind if people get a little emotional today, Amen. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Livebloggish comments, to be added when we feel like it: &lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;10:42:&lt;/strong&gt; Hillary&#39;s reference to the biblical Elijah standing up to the &#34;corrupt King Ahab and Queen Jezebel&#34; went over big with this biblically-literate crowd. HILLARY CALLED MELON A &lt;em&gt;JEZEBEL,&lt;/em&gt; OMG!!!!!&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;10:53: &lt;/strong&gt;Nancy Pelosi has been crying. She noted that it&#39;s traditional to leave a seat at the table for the prophet Elijah, and that Elijah Cummings &#34;always made a place at the table&#34; for others. And now we&#39;re tearing up a little too. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;11:05:&lt;/strong&gt; Kweisi Mfume says he and Cumings would occasionally call each other on their birthdays, but not every year, to keep it a surprise. Yesterday was Mfume&#39;s birthday, &#34;and I didn&#39;t get a call from my friend.&#34; That was lovely. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;11:12:&lt;/strong&gt; Mfume&#39;s affection for his friend is just beautiful. Truly a moving tribute, connecting the history of black America to the achievements of Cummings, and to &#34;the young Elijahs&#34; yet to come. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;11:25: &lt;/strong&gt;Johns Hopkins law prof Larry Gibson&#39;s reminiscences of his friend were so sweet. No rhetorical fireworks, just love.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;11:45:&lt;/strong&gt; Cummings&#39;s daughter Jennifer is simply making us sniffle constantly. What a fine dad, what a fine daughter. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;11:51:&lt;/strong&gt; Adia Cummings is wonderful, too. &#34;A parent&#39;s job is to see their child as God sees them.&#34; And that&#39;s how we should all see each other. Don&#39;t care if it&#39;s from a greeting card, don&#39;t care that I&#39;m not a believer, that&#39;s perfect. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;11:55:&lt;/strong&gt; James Cummings, Elijah&#39;s younger brother, reveals the family all called the congressman &#34;Bobby&#34; because an aunt didn&#39;t like the name &#34;Elijah.&#34; And James goes by his middle name, Al. Could we please get a DVD of their family dinners? &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;12:04: &lt;/strong&gt;John Alexander, who was mentored by Cummings and was on his first-term staff, recalls that when he was going through a rough patch, Cummings told him &#34;I won&#39;t let you fall.&#34; What more can one person say for another? Yeah, more tears, shut up. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;12:25:&lt;/strong&gt; Maya Rockeymoore Cummings is giving a passionate speech about her late husband&#39;s commitments to fighting for good government and for the planet. Yes, people will say it&#39;s essentially an announcement speech for her bid to succeed him in the seat, and we don&#39;t see anything wrong with that. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;12:30:&lt;/strong&gt; &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class=&#34;shortcode-media shortcode-media-twitter_embed&#34;&gt;
        &lt;iframe width=&#34;100%&#34; height=&#34;150&#34; scrolling=&#34;no&#34; id=&#34;twitter-embed-1187768669595668481&#34; src=&#34;/res/community/twitter_embed/?iframe_id=twitter-embed-1187768669595668481&amp;created_ts=1572021093.0&amp;screen_name=MrsCMitch&amp;text=%40MayaRockeymoore+%28%23ElijahCummings+wife%29+in+reference+to+the+service+that+was+held+for+him+in+the+Capital+%26amp%3B+him+bein%E2%80%A6+https%3A%2F%2Ft.co%2F4sIqGpZPEL&amp;id=1187768669595668481&amp;name=Clarene+Mitchell&#34; frameborder=&#34;0&#34; class=&#34;rm-shortcode&#34; data-rm-shortcode-id=&#34;DJDER01572025561&#34;&gt;&lt;/iframe&gt;
        &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;12:33:&lt;/strong&gt; Bill Clinton recalls having to follow Elijah Cummings at an appearance in 1992, says he&#39;s relieved he doesn&#39;t have to try to top Barack Obama today. :) &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;10:35:&lt;/strong&gt; Clinton recalls the prophet Isaiah saying, &#34;Here am I, lord, send me.&#34; And that was always Elijah Cummings: &#34;send me.&#34;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;10:40:&lt;/strong&gt; Praising Cummings&#39;s dedication to his oath to uphold and defend the Constitution is definitely intended as a comparison to another current figure, yes it is. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;12:42:&lt;/strong&gt; &#34;You can&#39;t run a free society if you have to hate everybody you disagree with.&#34; Amen. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;(Amended to add, &#34;but some people seem determined to make that difficult.)&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;12:50:&lt;/strong&gt; The President is speaking. Sometimes people say they&#39;re praying for you, but you aren&#39;t sure. They may be praying about you. But Elijah Cummings&#39;s mother, he could tell. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;12:55: &lt;/strong&gt;&#34;Being a strong man includes being kind. There&#39;s nothing weak about compassion. There&#39;s nothing weak about being honorable. You&#39;re not a sucker to have integrity.&#34;  Again, that one was pointed, as is the observation that not everyone with &#34;The hon.&#34; before their name are actually honorable. But Cummings &#34;was honorable before he ever took office.&#34;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;12:58:&lt;/strong&gt; &#34;He reminded us our time is too short not to fight for what is best, for what is true, for what is best about America.&#34;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;1:00:&lt;/strong&gt; Oh, how we miss a president who speaks in full sentences. While we search for a video clip of Obama&#39;s speech, here&#39;s another sample of Maya Rockeymoore Cummings: &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class=&#34;shortcode-media shortcode-media-twitter_embed&#34;&gt;
        &lt;iframe width=&#34;100%&#34; height=&#34;150&#34; scrolling=&#34;no&#34; id=&#34;twitter-embed-1187772572147912704&#34; src=&#34;/res/community/twitter_embed/?iframe_id=twitter-embed-1187772572147912704&amp;created_ts=1572022023.0&amp;screen_name=politico&amp;text=Maya+Rockeymoore-Cummings+honored+her+husband+Elijah+in+a+powerful+speech+moments+before+Clinton+and+Obama+took+the%E2%80%A6+https%3A%2F%2Ft.co%2F5iZNVF5KNr&amp;id=1187772572147912704&amp;name=POLITICO&#34; frameborder=&#34;0&#34; class=&#34;rm-shortcode&#34; data-rm-shortcode-id=&#34;G8K4N51572025561&#34;&gt;&lt;/iframe&gt;
        &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;1:05: &lt;/strong&gt; Here we go! &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class=&#34;shortcode-media shortcode-media-twitter_embed&#34;&gt;
        &lt;iframe width=&#34;100%&#34; height=&#34;150&#34; scrolling=&#34;no&#34; id=&#34;twitter-embed-1187777207793569793&#34; src=&#34;/res/community/twitter_embed/?iframe_id=twitter-embed-1187777207793569793&amp;created_ts=1572023128.0&amp;screen_name=CBSNews&amp;text=%E2%80%9CElijah+Cummings+was%C2%A0honorable+before+he+was+elected%C2%A0office%E2%80%9D%3A+Attendees+cheer+as+Former+President+Barack+Obama+spea%E2%80%A6+https%3A%2F%2Ft.co%2FYA7YSbv808&amp;id=1187777207793569793&amp;name=CBS+News&#34; frameborder=&#34;0&#34; class=&#34;rm-shortcode&#34; data-rm-shortcode-id=&#34;UH033U1572025561&#34;&gt;&lt;/iframe&gt;
        &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;1:10:&lt;/strong&gt; Bishop Walter Thomas: We often speak of &#34;speaking truth to power.&#34; But all too often, power isn&#39;t there. Today, he says, the powerful are all here, and let&#39;s hope they&#39;re listening to Elijah Cummings (I am paraphrasing like crazy here).&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;1:20: &lt;/strong&gt;This is some preaching! &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;1:40:&lt;/strong&gt; And that was a beautiful farewell for a true exemplar of a human being. It is well with my soul. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;br/&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;[&lt;a href=&#34;https://www.baltimoresun.com/politics/bs-md-pol-obama-cummings-funeral-20191024-h7n2yqflnjcfpl6dbl6lfx3g2u-story.html&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Baltimore Sun&lt;/a&gt; / &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.vox.com/policy-and-politics/2019/10/24/20930359/obama-clinton-elijah-cummings-funeral-livestream-schedule&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Vox &lt;/a&gt;/ &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.courier-journal.com/story/news/politics/mitch-mcconnell/2019/10/25/elijah-cummings-funeral-pallbearer-snubs-mitch-mcconnell-handshake/4094900002/&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Louisville Courier Journal&lt;/a&gt; / &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.huffpost.com/entry/reflections-on-the-wellst_b_15459&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;HuffPo &lt;/a&gt;/ Photo: &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.flickr.com/photos/afge/35444740372/in/photostream/&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;American Federation of Government Employees,&lt;/a&gt; Creative Commons &lt;a href=&#34;https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;License 2.0&lt;/a&gt;]&lt;br/&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Yr Wonkette is supported entirely by reader donations. <h1 class="widget__headline h1">
<a aria-label="Six Things Your Idiot Uncle Walter Doesn't Understand About The Impeachment Of Donald Trump" class="widget__headline-text custom-post-headline" href="https://www.wonkette.com/six-things-your-dumbass-right-wing-uncle-walter-doesnt-understand-about-the-impeachment-of-donald-j-trump">
    Six Things Your Idiot Uncle Walter Doesn't Understand About The Impeachment Of Donald Trump
</a></h1>
<div class="social-author clearfix">
<div class="social-author__avatar image">
<div class="cover-all image" style='background-image: url("https://assets.rbl.ms/18110596/210x.jpg")'></div>

<div class="body js-expandable clearfix js-listicle-body css-listicle-body-2641079531">
<div class="body-description"><div class="widget__brief"><p>It's nigh the end of October, and before we know it, you'll be sitting down to eat green bean casserole and fried turkey (yes, fried if you know what is good for you) and drink one hundred bottles of wine with your family, including your dumbass Fox News-obsessed <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K3Pd_XRwf_Y" target="_blank">Uncle Walter,</a> who will go on and on to the point that you become viciously angry with the rest of your family for leaving you there so long with Uncle Walter.</p><p class="shortcode-media shortcode-media-youtube">
<span class="rm-shortcode" data-rm-shortcode-id="BGHYUH1572101188" style="display:block;position:relative;padding-top:56.25%;"><iframe frameborder="0" height="auto" lazy-loadable="true" scrolling="no" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/K3Pd_XRwf_Y?rel=0" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;" width="100%"></iframe></span>
<small class="image-media media-caption" placeholder="Add Photo Caption...">Uncle Walter - Ben Folds Five</small>
<small class="image-media media-photo-credit" placeholder="Add Photo Credit...">
<a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K3Pd_XRwf_Y" target="_blank">www.youtube.com</a>
</small>
</p><p>And surprise, your Uncle Walter is going to be saying a lot of #WrongShit about the impeachment of Donald Trump, which despite what you might be hearing in the news, will most likely not have moved to the Senate at that point. So in light of the fact that it is <a href="https://www.mcsweeneys.net/articles/its-decorative-gourd-season-motherfuckers" target="_blank">decorative gourd season, motherfuckers,</a> and since we are only 24 hours removed from <a href="https://www.wonkette.com/matt-gaetzs-moron-rebellion-leaves-mark-on-impeachment-inquiry-a-skidmark" target="_blank">Matt Gaetz and pals leaving skidmarks</a> and pizza crusts all over the impeachment inquiry in the House, we thought it might be a nice time to briefly tick through six very stupid things your idiot right-wing Uncle Walter thinks about impeachment, and why he is<br/></p><p class="shortcode-media shortcode-media-rebelmouse-image">
<a href="https://media1.giphy.com/media/hPPx8yk3Bmqys/giphy.gif?cid=2fb0ca7662d02004073d4f5d245b005ecd480ed5da32b7ff&amp;rid=giphy.gif" target="_blank"><img class="rm-shortcode" data-rm-shortcode-id="9KORSP1572101188" data-rm-shortcode-name="rebelmouse-image" id="b25d9" lazy-loadable="true" src="https://assets.rebelmouse.io/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpbWFnZSI6Imh0dHBzOi8vYXNzZXRzLnJibC5tcy8yMjAyOTEzMy9vcmlnaW4uZ2lmIiwiZXhwaXJlc19hdCI6MTU3Mjc3Njg5M30.afcHTyqOFODoq4RuZTGZoRw2_XeJwq1BErH4Wpvs8jU/img.gif?width=980"/></a>
<small class="image-media media-photo-credit" placeholder="Add Photo Credit...">
<a href="https://giphy.com/gifs/request-donald-wrong-hPPx8yk3Bmqys" target="_blank">Giphy</a>
</small>
</p><p><br/></p><p>Feel free to store these as ammunition. Or just throw turkey legs at your right-wing Uncle Walter's face instead, we don't care.</p></div>
<div class="js-appear-on-expand">
<script type="keep-reading-content">&lt;h2&gt;SECTION ONE: The Crimening!&lt;/h2&gt;&lt;h3&gt;1. Everybody Does Quid Pro Quos In Foreign Policy! They Are The Hottest Thing, Quid Pro Quos!&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;p&gt;Here is a stupid idiot on Fox News saying &#34;all this discussion of quid pro quo is really misleading, because all foreign relations is quid pro quo&#34; and it is a &#34;staple of all negotiations.&#34; &lt;br/&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class=&#34;shortcode-media shortcode-media-twitter_embed&#34;&gt;
        &lt;iframe width=&#34;100%&#34; height=&#34;150&#34; scrolling=&#34;no&#34; id=&#34;twitter-embed-1187013938430521345&#34; src=&#34;/res/community/twitter_embed/?iframe_id=twitter-embed-1187013938430521345&amp;created_ts=1571841151.0&amp;screen_name=LisPower1&amp;text=Really+loving+the+%27well+actually%2C+quid+pro+quo+is+good+and+smart%27+defenses%0A%0AFox+Contributor+Andy+McCarthy%3A+%22All+thi%E2%80%A6+https%3A%2F%2Ft.co%2FEa58k76eLM&amp;id=1187013938430521345&amp;name=Lis+Power&#34; frameborder=&#34;0&#34; class=&#34;rm-shortcode&#34; data-rm-shortcode-id=&#34;VKBH7W1572014774&#34;&gt;&lt;/iframe&gt;
        &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Yes, well, this is true, sort of, except for go fuck yourself. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Absolutely&lt;/em&gt; in the course of normal foreign policy, there are deals made and quids exchanged for quos when one country wants one thing that is in that country&#39;s interest and another country wants another thing that is in &lt;em&gt;that&lt;/em&gt; country&#39;s interest, and they make a deal and say &#34;We will do that thing if you do this other thing.&#34; Hooray! &lt;br/&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;However, nothing in the Trump Ukraine scandal involves America getting anything &lt;em&gt;for America&lt;/em&gt;. Ukraine is over here desperately needing continued military aid and support for &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/is-trumps-ukraine-treason-sh-t-about-russian-sanctions-yeah-sure-why-wouldnt-it-be&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;its war against Russia,&lt;/a&gt; which invaded in 2014 and has been occupying the Crimean peninsula ever since. Meanwhile Donald Trump wants things that are for &lt;em&gt;his&lt;/em&gt; benefit, not &lt;em&gt;America&lt;/em&gt;&#39;s benefit. Trump was demanding, in exchange for already-appropriated military aid and the honor of a White House visit, that the president of Ukraine &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/we-need-to-talk-more-about-the-deliverable-trump-wanted-from-ukraine&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;announce fake investigations&lt;/a&gt; on CNN into &lt;em&gt;his political rivals&lt;/em&gt;, in order to help him win re-election in 2020, and to re-write the narrative of the 2016 election, thereby legitimizing his presidency and absolving our adversary Russia of guilt.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Sure, your right-wing Uncle Walter might think it is in the best interests of the country for Trump to be re-elected, but that&#39;s his &lt;em&gt;opinion&lt;/em&gt;, because he is &lt;em&gt;dumb&lt;/em&gt;. Clearly it&#39;s in America&#39;s best interests to kick the motherfucker out of the White House and lead him away in chains. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;But that&#39;s &lt;em&gt;politics&lt;/em&gt;. It would be bad if Joe Biden or Bernie Sanders were offering another nation all the butterscotches in their pockets to gin up fake evidence about Trump. It&#39;s worse because Trump is abusing his power as head of state to help himself politically.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;h3&gt;2. NO QUID PRO QUO! NO QUID PRO QUO! TRUMP FULLY EXONERATED!&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;p&gt;That said, the existence or non-existence of a quid pro quo is not actually the point here. Trump has &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/trump-says-no-quid-pro-quo-because-oh-rats-it-appears-hes-lying-again&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;wailed this week&lt;/a&gt; that there isn&#39;t a quid pro quo, because Ukraine didn&#39;t know he was withholding the military aid (yes there was, and yes they did), and &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/mick-mulvaney-trump-commits-a-lot-of-crimes-get-over-it&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Mick Mulvaney said&lt;/a&gt; there &lt;em&gt;totally&lt;/em&gt; was a quid pro quo last week, until he &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/who-you-gonna-believe-mick-mulvaney-or-that-dumb-liar-mick-mulvaney&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;changed his mind&lt;/a&gt; about that 15 minutes later after everyone realized he had confessed to extortion on behalf of the president. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;But we have said this a THOUSAND times, and we will have to say it a THOUSAND more, that the &lt;em&gt;central crime&lt;/em&gt; here is Donald Trump demanding Ukraine contribute to his re-election campaign by announcing investigations into the Bidens and the 2016 conspiracy theories that make Trump&#39;s butt itch. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Back in the summer, &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/hello-fbi-wed-like-to-report-a-crime-in-progress&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Trump admitted&lt;/a&gt; -- while this Ukraine scheme was going on, we just didn&#39;t know it yet -- to George Stephanopoulos that if a foreign country has dirt on his opponents, then hell yeah he wants it! &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;In response, the exasperated chair of the FEC &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/how-much-hostile-foreign-assistance-is-trump-expecting-in-2020-kayleigh-mcenany-f-ck&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;explained what is the law&lt;/a&gt; for the dumb kids in the back:&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class=&#34;shortcode-media shortcode-media-twitter_embed&#34;&gt;
        &lt;iframe width=&#34;100%&#34; height=&#34;150&#34; scrolling=&#34;no&#34; id=&#34;twitter-embed-1139309394968096768&#34; src=&#34;/res/community/twitter_embed/?iframe_id=twitter-embed-1139309394968096768&amp;created_ts=1560467501.0&amp;screen_name=EllenLWeintraub&amp;text=I+would+not+have+thought+that+I+needed+to+say+this.+https%3A%2F%2Ft.co%2FT743CsXq79&amp;id=1139309394968096768&amp;name=Ellen+L+Weintraub&#34; frameborder=&#34;0&#34; class=&#34;rm-shortcode&#34; data-rm-shortcode-id=&#34;HESIOT1572014774&#34;&gt;&lt;/iframe&gt;
        &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Got it? There was a quid pro quo, but it actually doesn&#39;t fucking matter, because THAT IS THE LAW RIGHT THERE. The fact that Trump added more crimes like cherries on top is just gravy. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;(Yes, it&#39;s giblet gravy on top of cherries that are on top of the real turkey, which is the central crime. Maybe you can use the food on the Thanksgiving table as a visual aid! Remember to save the turkey legs to throw at Uncle Walter&#39;s face.)&lt;/p&gt;&lt;h3&gt;3. Trump TOO STUPID To Know Crimes He&#39;s Committing, So They DON&#39;T COUNT!&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;p&gt;Oh FUCK OFF. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;But yes, the &lt;em&gt;Wall Street Journal&lt;/em&gt; is &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wsj.com/articles/schiffs-secret-bombshells-11571872974?redirect=amp#click=https://t.co/TluJ3dC41s&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;saying in an editorial today&lt;/a&gt; that Trump may have been too &#34;inept&#34; to pull off his Ukraine scheme, which means it doesn&#39;t count, and that is also why nobody goes to prison for attempted murder if the court determines the perp was just too much of a dumbshit to properly kill his victim all the way dead.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;It was mildly funny when Robert Mueller &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/juniors-too-dumb-to-be-indicted-mueller-report-liveblog-part-two&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;decided not to bring charges&lt;/a&gt; against Donald Trump Jr. for conspiring with Russians during the 2016 campaign because he determined Junior was simply too stupid to be indicted. It&#39;s not cute anymore, it&#39;s 2019, not 2016, and we are talking about the president of the United States, not his uncomfortable-faced failson.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;h2&gt;SECTION TWO: Let&#39;s Whine About PROCESSSSSSS, Because We Ain&#39;t Got Shit Else To Say In Defense Of President Treason McYapfuck!&lt;/h2&gt;&lt;p&gt;All of the preceding section notwithstanding, you might have noticed that congressional Republicans and Fox News idiots actually don&#39;t want to talk too much about what Trump did or did not do with Ukraine, because of how what Trump clearly did is clearly indefensible. Instead, they want to bitch and moan and whine and shit their pants about &lt;em&gt;process&lt;/em&gt;. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;That&#39;s what Matt Gaetz and the walking anal glands on the Freedom Caucus were bellyaching about yesterday as they rubbed pizza crusts in their armpits and stuck them under the desktops in the congressional SCIF like wadded up bubble gum.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Proceesssssssssssss! It&#39;s all they got. And they&#39;re mad they&#39;re being deprived of the opportunity to turn hearings in the impeachment inquiry into a total shitshow to impress Big Treason in the White House. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;So the next three things on our list of things your dumbass Uncle Walter doesn&#39;t quite understand about impeachment are about the bad-faith complaints these dumb frumpy shitmouths have about the &lt;em&gt;process&lt;/em&gt; of how the impeachment inquiry is playing out. Of course, we are copy/pasting ourselves here because &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/adam-schiff-to-whiny-republicans-calm-your-f-cking-balls&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;ADAM SCHIFF FUCKING EXPLAINED THIS LAST WEEK&lt;/a&gt; IN A LETTER HE WROTE TO EVERY SINGLE GODDAMNED ONE OF HIS COLLEAGUES.&lt;em&gt;&lt;/em&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;h3&gt;4. WAAAAAAAAAH! The Republicans Aren&#39;t Even Allowed In The Room When The Democrats Are Questioning Witnesses! WAAAAAAAAAH!&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;p&gt;Pop quiz, do you know how many of Matt Gaetz&#39;s Squad Of Dumbfucks actually sit on the committees leading the impeachment inquiry? We don&#39;t know either because we haven&#39;t counted, but it&#39;s a good number of &#39;em! &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;This is relevant because as Schiff explained in his letter, everyone who sits on those committees, yes even the Republicans, has equal time and representation to question witnesses. This counts for members and staff and counsel for both sides. Not equally represented? Republicans who &lt;em&gt;aren&#39;t on those committees&lt;/em&gt;. Also Democrats who &lt;em&gt;aren&#39;t on those committees&lt;/em&gt;!&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;For the record, here is a list of all the people allowed to go to these depositions who have R&#39;s next to their names. There are 48 of them:&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class=&#34;shortcode-media shortcode-media-twitter_embed&#34;&gt;
        &lt;iframe width=&#34;100%&#34; height=&#34;150&#34; scrolling=&#34;no&#34; id=&#34;twitter-embed-1187030655252815877&#34; src=&#34;/res/community/twitter_embed/?iframe_id=twitter-embed-1187030655252815877&amp;created_ts=1571845136.0&amp;screen_name=geoffgarin&amp;text=There+are+48+Republican+House+members+who+are+entitled+to+attend+the+depositions+being+taken+in+connection+with+the%E2%80%A6+https%3A%2F%2Ft.co%2FQYQXU14Iam&amp;id=1187030655252815877&amp;name=Geoff+Garin&#34; frameborder=&#34;0&#34; class=&#34;rm-shortcode&#34; data-rm-shortcode-id=&#34;83DA851572014774&#34;&gt;&lt;/iframe&gt;
        &lt;/p&gt;&lt;h3&gt;5. WAAAAAAAAH! They Shouldn&#39;t Be Behind Closed Doors Anyway! What Are They Hiding? WAAAAAAAAH!&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;p&gt;Yes, they should be behind closed doors right now. As Schiff explained in his letter, these depositions are behind closed doors for now for two reasons: 1) because they didn&#39;t have the benefit of an Impeachment Road Map handed to them by a special counsel like they had in the Clinton and Nixon impeachments, therefore they have to do this initial investigation themselves; and 2) they don&#39;t want witnesses comparing notes on their testimonies and trying to get their cover stories straight. This has already had the result of Trump idiot EU Ambassador Gordon Sondland LOOKS LIKE MAYBE falling into the idiot trap and &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/sondland-sticking-with-im-an-idiot-and-so-can-you-defense&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;lying to Congress,&lt;/a&gt; after Ambassador Bill Taylor&#39;s testimony &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/bill-taylors-testimony-is-holy-sh-t-wow-and-trump-is-f-cked&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;backed a Mack truck&lt;/a&gt; up all over Sondland&#39;s testimony.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;And no, it&#39;s not against the rules. Here, let FOX NEWS JUDGE Andrew Napolitano explain how they are abiding by the rules passed and signed in 2015 by then-House Speaker (Republican) John Boehner:&lt;/p&gt;&lt;video width=&#34;100%&#34; controls&gt;
  &lt;source src=&#34;https://s3.amazonaws.com/roar-assets-auto.rbl.ms/runner%2F14815-naprules1.mp4&#34; type=&#34;video/mp4&#34;&gt;
  Your browser does not support the video tag.
&lt;/video&gt;&lt;p&gt;That said, Adam Schiff has said the hearings will go public when Adam Schiff decides he&#39;s good and ready so CALM YOUR FUCKING BALLS.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;h3&gt;6. WAAAAAAAAAAH! Trump Is Not Getting Due Process And Can&#39;t Call Witnesses To TOTALLY EXONERATE Him And WAAAAAaaaaaaaHh1hHH1Hhh1hh1h1hGHAZI1!11!!!&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;p&gt;That&#39;s. Not. How. The fuck. This. Works.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;What&#39;s happening right now is an &lt;em&gt;impeachment inquiry&lt;/em&gt; to determine if the House Judiciary Committee should approve articles of impeachment, and which ones, to send them to the full House for a vote. This is not the trial portion of impeachment. That happens in the Senate, where Trump will get all those things and his &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/trump-lawyers-defend-his-constitutional-right-to-shoot-someone-on-fifth-avenue&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;idiot lawyer can argue&lt;/a&gt; that Trump can shoot babies in the middle of Fifth Avenue and the cops aren&#39;t even allowed to stop him, and moreover that Congress has no power, does not exist, and is in fact a figment of your imagination. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;What&#39;s happening right now is more like a grand jury situation where they are collecting evidence from witnesses. These are not even the House Judiciary Committee&#39;s official impeachment hearings, which yes, will be televised. &lt;span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Here, let FOX NEWS JUDGE Andrew Napolitano explain how they are abiding by the rules on this part too, DID YOU SEE THIS ON FOX NEWS, UNCLE WALTER YOU DUMBFUCK? DID YOU SEE IT?&lt;/p&gt;&lt;video width=&#34;100%&#34; controls&gt;
  &lt;source src=&#34;https://s3.amazonaws.com/roar-assets-auto.rbl.ms/runner%2F14816-naprules2.mp4&#34; type=&#34;video/mp4&#34;&gt;
  Your browser does not support the video tag.

<h1 class="widget__headline h1">
<a aria-label="In Which Jane Fonda Gives Her BAFTA Award Acceptance Speech Mid-Arrest" class="widget__headline-text custom-post-headline" href="https://www.wonkette.com/in-which-jane-fonda-gives-her-bafta-award-acceptance-speech-mid-arrest">
    In Which Jane Fonda Gives Her BAFTA Award Acceptance Speech Mid-Arrest
</a></h1>
<div class="widget__subheadline">
<h2 class="widget__subheadline-text h2"><p>Also this is your open thread!</p></h2>
</div>
<div class="social-author clearfix">
<div class="social-author__avatar image">

<div class="body-description"><p>For the last several weeks, Jane Fonda and friends have been getting arrested during her Fire Drill Friday climate change protests, and, in turn, providing us with a ton of adorable photo and video ops to swoon over. I mean, come on, Jack McCoy getting arrested to save the planet? </p><p class="shortcode-media shortcode-media-twitter_embed">
<iframe class="rm-shortcode" data-rm-shortcode-id="JOKQVM1572123924" frameborder="0" height="0" id="twitter-embed-1185231929555202049" scrolling="no" src="/res/community/twitter_embed/?iframe_id=twitter-embed-1185231929555202049&amp;created_ts=1571416287.0&amp;screen_name=FireDrillFriday&amp;text=Sam+Waterston+getting+arrested+for+the+first+time+for+a+%23GreenNewDeal+%23firedrillfriday+https%3A%2F%2Ft.co%2FyRfvJagB9G&amp;id=1185231929555202049&amp;name=Fire+Drill+Fridays" width="100%"></iframe>
</p><p>SHOOT IT DIRECTLY INTO MY VEINS (AND ALSO SOMEHOW MAKE IT A STORY ARC ON AN UPCOMING EPISODE OF SVU).<br/></p><p>And Ted Danson's adorable face while getting arrested? </p><p class="shortcode-media shortcode-media-twitter_embed">
<iframe class="rm-shortcode" data-rm-shortcode-id="XVMFMT1572123924" frameborder="0" height="0" id="twitter-embed-1187781955456249856" scrolling="no" src="/res/community/twitter_embed/?iframe_id=twitter-embed-1187781955456249856&amp;created_ts=1572024260.0&amp;screen_name=cxpxldi&amp;text=TED+DANSON+AND+JANE+FONDA+BEING+ARRESTED+TOGETHER+FUCKING+AMAZING+https%3A%2F%2Ft.co%2FHkAh0FRUsx&amp;id=1187781955456249856&amp;name=jailbird+ted+danson" width="100%"></iframe>
</p><p>Glorious. </p><p>Not to be outdone at her own protest, and unable to attend the BAFTA awards ceremony in person, Fonda accepted her Stanley Kubrick Britannia Award For Excellence In Film (probably for <em>Barbarella</em>) in a video, while she was being arrested. </p><p class="shortcode-media shortcode-media-twitter_embed">
<iframe class="rm-shortcode" data-rm-shortcode-id="VPS46K1572123924" frameborder="0" height="0" id="twitter-embed-1187950061990207489" scrolling="no" src="/res/community/twitter_embed/?iframe_id=twitter-embed-1187950061990207489&amp;created_ts=1572064340.0&amp;screen_name=BAFTALA&amp;text=Folks%2C+%40Janefonda+accepted+the+Stanley+Kubrick+Britannia+Award+WHILE+BEING+ARRESTED.+%23Britannias+https%3A%2F%2Ft.co%2FLDbZKTZWrs&amp;id=1187950061990207489&amp;name=BAFTA+Los+Angeles" width="100%"></iframe>
</p><p>How bad ass is that? </p><p>Previously, <a href="https://www.washingtonpost.com/climate-environment/jane-fonda-plans-climate-change-civil-disobedience-on-the-capitol-steps/2019/10/10/c7cd534e-eab1-11e9-9306-47cb0324fd44_story.html" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Fonda has vowed</a> to continue getting arrested in an act of civil disobedience for fourteen Fridays in a row, until she has to resume filming for <em>Grace and Frankie,</em> a very good Netflix show in which Lili Tomlin plays my mom: </p><blockquote>"I'm going to take my body, which is kind of famous and popular right now because of the [television] series and I'm going to go to D.C. and I'm going to have a rally every Friday," Fonda said in an interview with The Washington Post. "It'll be called 'Fire Drill Friday.' And we're going to engage in civil disobedience and we're going to get arrested every Friday."</blockquote><p>Good for her! Might as well use that privilege for something! <br/></p><p>Anyway, this is now your open thread! <h1 class="widget__headline h1">
<a aria-label="Meme-Famous Anti-Immigrant Lady Arrested For Stealing An Elderly Person's Hotel Points" class="widget__headline-text custom-post-headline" href="https://www.wonkette.com/meme-famous-anti-immigrant-lady-arrested-for-stealing-an-elderly-persons-hotel-points">
    Meme-Famous Anti-Immigrant Lady Arrested For Stealing An Elderly Person's Hotel Points
</a></h1>
<div class="widget__subheadline">
<h2 class="widget__subheadline-text h2"><p>Jennifer Harrison was famously laughed at by 'Green Shirt Guy'</p></h2>
</div>
<div class="social-author clearfix">
<div class="social-author__avatar image">
<div class="cover-all image" style='background-image: url("https://assets.rbl.ms/17399306/210x.jpg")'></div>
</div>
<a class="social-author__name" href="https://www.wonkette.com/u/robyn_pennacchia">Robyn Pennacchia</a>
</div>
<div class="social-date">
<span class="social-date__text">October 26, 2019 03:15 PM</span>
</div>
<div class="body js-expandable clearfix js-listicle-body css-listicle-body-2641114458">
<div class="body-description"><div class="widget__brief"><p>
	Back in August, Jennifer Harrison of Arizona became part of a viral sensation after her anti-immigration rant at a local town hall caused a mustachioed man in a green shirt to burst into a fit of laughter. Said rant, which was not entirely intelligible, was accessorized with a large sign reading "RESPECT OUR LAWS OR BE DEPORTED!"
</p><p>
	Please to recall:
</p><p class="shortcode-media shortcode-media-youtube">
<span class="rm-shortcode" data-rm-shortcode-id="Q2VLJZ1572120325" style="display:block;position:relative;padding-top:56.25%;"><iframe frameborder="0" height="auto" lazy-loadable="true" scrolling="no" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/4B18DoyXZu4?rel=0" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;" width="100%"></iframe></span>
<small class="image-media media-caption" placeholder="Add Photo Caption...">Green shirt guy</small>
<small class="image-media media-photo-credit" placeholder="Add Photo Credit...">
<a href="https://youtu.be/4B18DoyXZu4" target="_blank">youtu.be</a>
</small>
</p></div>
<div class="js-appear-on-expand">
<script type="keep-reading-content">&lt;p&gt;
	One therefore might assume (or not) that Jennifer Harrison would be a big fan of respecting laws herself. Alas, this appears to not be the case at &lt;em&gt;all&lt;/em&gt;, as Harrison was recently arrested for identity theft. More specifically, she was arrested and charged on one count of taking the identity of another, which is a Class 4 felony — a charge, ironically, most often used against undocumented immigrants who get jobs under other people&#39;s names and social security numbers. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Was it because she needed to go into hiding after having made a national embarrassment of herself? No, it was not. It is, in fact doubtful that Harrison possesses anywhere near that amount of self-awareness. &lt;br/&gt;
&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;
	Rather, Harrison allegedly &#34;stole an elderly victim&#39;s hotel points&#34; in order to attend the Aftershock Festival in Sacramento. To be fair, the festival had an absolutely incredible lineup of bands you had no idea were bands anymore, including Slipknot, Staind, Korn, Blink-182, The Crystal Method, Sum 41 and Stone Temple Pilots, somehow, even though Scott Weiland is dead. Oh, and the Dropkick Murphy&#39;s, who will show up at the opening of a can of beer if requested. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;
	Via &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.azcentral.com/story/news/local/surprise-breaking/2019/10/25/jennifer-harrison-az-patriots-arrested-accused-identity-theft/2460167001/&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;AZ Central:&lt;/a&gt;
&lt;/p&gt;&lt;blockquote&gt;
	When she was arrested and transferred to a Surprise police station, she told officers she was innocent and did not cooperate with police, the court document says. &lt;br/&gt;
	&lt;br/&gt;
	&#34;Jennifer created a scene at the PD (police department) and in the booking room because she believes she is above the law and does not want to be treated like a criminal,&#34; the document says.&lt;br/&gt;
	&lt;br/&gt;
	Police also said she kicked over a trash can and used profanity, the statement says.&lt;br/&gt;
	&lt;br/&gt;
	According to the probable cause statement, Harrison used the victim&#39;s name, address and club-reward points to make the hotel reservation.&lt;br/&gt;
	&lt;br/&gt;
	&#34;This was done without (the) knowledge and permission of the victim who is willing to aid in prosecution,&#34; the court document says.&lt;br/&gt;
	&lt;br/&gt;
	According to her Facebook account, Harrison attended the &lt;a href=&#34;https://aftershockfestival.com/lineup/&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Aftershock Festival&lt;/a&gt; in Sacramento, which happened from Oct. 11 to Oct. 13.&lt;br/&gt;
	&lt;br/&gt;
	In a message to The Arizona Republic via Facebook messenger, Harrison said, &#34;My attorney said no comment but you should wait until the truth comes out before you write a story.&#34;
&lt;/blockquote&gt;&lt;p&gt;Surprise police station refers to name of the town where she was arrested — not like &#34;Surprise, you are in a police station being arrested for stealing an old person&#39;s hotel points!&#34; &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Harrison, by the way, is not just a weirdo who randomly shows up to town halls for the purpose of making a fool of herself. She is very organized about making a fool of herself and is the leader of a group of known as the &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.facebook.com/AZPatriotsUnited/&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;AZ Patriots&lt;/a&gt;, a group that was recently ordered by a judge to stop trespassing at several churches that were providing food, shelter and clothing to immigrant asylum-seekers released by ICE. Which, you know, means they&#39;re here legally. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;I was severely tempted to use the term &#34;Arizona trashbag&#34; somewhere in here, but that would be an insult to Eleanor Shellstrop, who — even at her very worst, was still better than this one. In any case, it is highly unlikely that we have seen the last of Jennifer Harrison, and I certainly look forward to her inevitable upcoming appearance on Tucker Carlson. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;[&lt;a href=&#34;https://www.azcentral.com/story/news/local/surprise-breaking/2019/10/25/jennifer-harrison-az-patriots-arrested-accused-identity-theft/2460167001/&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;AZ Central&lt;/a&gt;]&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Wonkette is independent and fully funded by readers like you. Click below to tip us!&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;form name=&#34;donation&#34; method=&#34;post&#34; class=&#34;donation-form&#34;&gt;&lt;p class=&#34;subheadline&#34;&gt;How often would you like to donate?&lt;/p&gt;&lt;div class=&#34;form-row row--plan&#34;&gt;&lt;label class=&#34;plan-type__label&#34;&gt;&lt;input type=&#34;radio&#34; name=&#34;plan_type&#34; value=&#34;once&#34; class=&#34;plan-type&#34; required checked&gt; Just once

<a class="widget__section js-load-brick-on-click" href="https://www.wonkette.com/2020-democratic-primary">2020 democratic primary</a>
<h1 class="widget__headline h1">
<a aria-label="Justice Kennedy Was Not Good, Mayor Pete. He Was Not Good." class="widget__headline-text custom-post-headline" href="https://www.wonkette.com/no-we-do-not-need-more-justice-kennedys-mayor-pete">
    Justice Kennedy Was Not Good, Mayor Pete. He Was Not Good.
</a></h1>
<div class="widget__subheadline">
<h2 class="widget__subheadline-text h2"><p>We do not need another one. </p></h2>
</div>
<div class="social-author clearfix">
<div class="social-author__avatar image">
<div class="cover-all image" style='background-image: url("https://wonkette.com/res/avatars/default")'></div>
</div>
<a class="social-author__name" href="https://www.wonkette.com/u/jamielynncrofts">Jamie Lynn Crofts</a>
</div>
<div class="social-date">
<span class="social-date__text">October 26, 2019 02:07 PM</span>
</div>
<div class="body js-expandable clearfix js-listicle-body css-listicle-body-2641113826">
<div class="body-description"><div class="widget__brief"><p>Say it ain't so, Pete.</p><p>In an <a href="https://www.cosmopolitan.com/politics/a29550621/pete-buttigieg-cosmopolitan-interview-medicare-scotus/" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">interview with Cosmo</a> this week, Mayor Pete Buttigieg decided to talk about his plans for the Supreme Court by ... praising former Supreme Court Justice and lifelong Republican Anthony Kennedy, who stepped down so Donald Trump could put Brett Kavanaugh on the Court.</p><blockquote>So I've floated several ideas and deliberately kept some level of open-mindedness about which ones are going to work best. One of them would be to have 15 members, but 5 of them can only be seated if the other 10 unanimously agree. The idea here is you get more justices who think for themselves. Justices like Justice Kennedy or Justice Souter, and there are many legal scholars who think this could be done without a constitutional amendment under current law.</blockquote><p>Sigh.</p><p>Where to start?</p></div>
<div class="js-appear-on-expand">
<script type="keep-reading-content">&lt;p&gt;Anthony Kennedy is a lifelong Republican. He was appointed to the Ninth Circuit by Gerald Ford and to the Supreme Court by Ronald Reagan. Reagan nominated Kennedy after famously getting Borked when he tried to put Nixon Solicitor General Robert Bork and then  Douglas Ginsburg on the bench. While he occasionally broke with his buddies over on the right wing of the Court, he was generally a reliable conservative vote. As Jessica Mason Pieklo put it &lt;a href=&#34;https://rewire.news/article/2019/10/25/mayor-pete-justice-kennedy-and-the-myth-of-a-nonpartisan-supreme-court/&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;over at Rewire&lt;/a&gt;, &#34;there are few myths as persistent as the myth of Justice Anthony Kennedy as an independently minded justice and the Supreme Court as a nonpolitical institution[.]&#34;&lt;br/&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;In one of his last acts on the Supreme Court, Justice Kennedy was the deciding vote &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.supremecourt.gov/opinions/17pdf/17-965_h315.pdf&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;upholding Trump&#39;s Muslim ban&lt;/a&gt;. He wrote a concurrence that began, &#34;I join the Court&#39;s opinion in full.&#34; Kennedy literally wrote &lt;em&gt;&lt;a href=&#34;https://casetext.com/case/citizens-united-v-federal-election-comn?ref=Sb!ILRPD3&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Citizens United&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/em&gt;. He voted to strike down handgun bans in Washington, DC and Chicago. He routinely gave the green light to corporations to pollute our water, air, and land. He okayed Christian prayers at town council meetings. He helped make George W. Bush President in &lt;em&gt;Bush v. Gore&lt;/em&gt;. Kennedy voted that the federal government could criminalize medical marijuana even in states where it was legal -- in fact, he rarely saw a drug law he didn&#39;t approve of. He helped gut labor unions. He wrote the opinion upholding a federal ban on certain late-term abortions. Justice Kennedy voted to destroy the Voting Rights Act and uphold voter suppression.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;That is not my idea of someone who Democrats should be putting on the highest court in the land.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Yes, Justice Kennedy was good on LGBTQ rights. The &lt;em&gt;Obergefell &lt;/em&gt;opinion is beautifully written. I have friends who have had excerpts of it read at their weddings. As a bisexual woman (and civil rights lawyer), it was an incredibly important case for me. I will never forget the day marriage equality became the law of the land.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;But if Justice Kennedy &lt;em&gt;really &lt;/em&gt;cared about LGBTQ people or women, he wouldn&#39;t have cut a deal with Donald Trump to retire and put Kegs Kavanaugh on the Supreme Court. Kennedy waited through the 8 years of the Obama presidency to allow a Republican to appoint his replacement -- and not just any Republican, Donald fucking Trump. As it was put by &lt;a href=&#34;https://rewire.news/article/2019/10/25/mayor-pete-justice-kennedy-and-the-myth-of-a-nonpartisan-supreme-court/&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Rewire&lt;/a&gt;,&lt;/p&gt;&lt;blockquote&gt;[N]othing left LGBTQ people and Kennedy&#39;s own legacy more at risk than his decision last summer to retire. Unless Kennedy was living under a rock, he knew the Trump administration had the rights of LGBTQ people teed up for rollback and that anyone named to replace him would be a reliably anti-LGBTQ vote. Despite campaign promises to the contrary, President Trump has shown his administration is not at all interested in affirming the &#34;dignity&#34; of LGBTQ people that Kennedy&#39;s Obergefell decision praised. So when it came to choosing between the lives of LGBTQ people and the peace of mind of knowing a Republican would name his replacement, Kennedy chose the latter.&lt;/blockquote&gt;&lt;p&gt;The &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/scotus-preview&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;2020 Supreme Court term&lt;/a&gt; will see decisions about whether LGBTQ people are protected by federal civil rights laws and whether Louisiana can put absolutely bullshit restrictions on abortion access.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Pete&#39;s plan also fails to account for the damage that has already been done to the federal judiciary by Donald Trump and Mitch McConnell. Over 150 Trump appointees have already been put on the federal bench -- that&#39;s nearly a quarter of all federal judges. In addition to being unqualified and evil, a lot of them are very young. They will do damage to the country for decades to come. Unless drastic action is taken, I don&#39;t see this being fixed within my lifetime.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;With all of this in mind, I do want to point out that Pete &lt;a href=&#34;https://rewire.news/article/2019/10/25/mayor-pete-justice-kennedy-and-the-myth-of-a-nonpartisan-supreme-court/&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;changed his tune&lt;/a&gt; after getting a LOT of backlash from Democratic court watchers.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;blockquote&gt;To Buttigieg&#39;s credit, his campaign quickly reached out to Rewire.News to clarify the comments in Cosmopolitan. A spokesperson directed me to comments Buttigieg made at a campaign stop yesterday in New Hampshire where he identified Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg as the kind of justice he&#39;d nominate should he be elected president. He also released a policy plan this week designed to build power for women, and it includes using support for reproductive rights as a litmus test for future judicial nominees.&lt;/blockquote&gt;&lt;p&gt;So that&#39;s good. But we also need to stop the fetishization of Justice Kennedy as &#34;independent&#34; or the idea of someone a Democrat should ever be nominating. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;There are three incredible women on the Court who Democratic candidates like Pete can look to for inspiration. Give me another RBG, Elena Kagan, or Sonia Sotomayor any day.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Hopefully now, Mayor Pete will remember that he&#39;s running in the DEMOCRATIC primary?&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;[ &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.cosmopolitan.com/politics/a29550621/pete-buttigieg-cosmopolitan-interview-medicare-scotus/&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Cosmo&lt;/a&gt; / &lt;a href=&#34;https://rewire.news/article/2019/10/25/mayor-pete-justice-kennedy-and-the-myth-of-a-nonpartisan-supreme-court/&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Rewire&lt;/a&gt; ]&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Wonkette is independent and fully funded by readers like you.
