<h1 class="widget__headline h1">
<a aria-label="Katie Hill Was In The Closet Making Babies And I Saw One Of The Babies And The Baby Looked At Me!" class="widget__headline-text custom-post-headline" href="https://www.wonkette.com/katie-hill-had-sex-destroyed-country-somehow">
    Katie Hill Was In The Closet Making Babies And I Saw One Of The Babies And The Baby Looked At Me!
</a></h1>
<div class="widget__subheadline">
<h2 class="widget__subheadline-text h2"><p>Damn millennials with their avocado toast and consensual sexual relationships!</p></h2>
</div>
<div class="social-author clearfix">
<div class="social-author__avatar image">
<div class="cover-all image" style='background-image: url("https://assets.rbl.ms/18111476/210x.jpg")'></div>
</div>
<a class="social-author__name" href="https://www.wonkette.com/u/stephenrobinson">Stephen Robinson</a>
</div>
<div class="social-date">
<span class="social-date__text">October 25, 2019 01:05 PM</span>
</div>
<div class="body js-expandable clearfix js-listicle-body css-listicle-body-2641102282">
<div class="body-description"><div class="widget__brief"><p>Democrat Katie Hill is a freshman House member who flipped a California district that Republicans had held since 1993. Hill is a rising star, or rather she was. She's now the subject of a House ethics probe over a matter I don't think is anyone's business. Hill <a href="https://www.cnbc.com/2019/10/24/rep-katie-hill-admits-to-having-an-inappropriate-relationship-with-a-staffer.html" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">confirmed</a> that she had an "inappropriate relationship" with a female campaign staffer. However, she's denied an affair with her legislative director, Graham Kelly, who is a current member of her office staff.</p><p>House rules forbid a "sexual relationship with any employee of the House who works under the supervision of the Member, Delegate, or Resident Commissioner." It's a new rule the House implemented last year in response to longstanding allegations of sexual misconduct, specifically involving Michigan <a href="https://www.latimes.com/nation/ct-house-prohibits-relationships-20180206-story.html" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Rep. John Conyers.</a> But unlike Brutus, Conyers was not an honorable man. He was Dabney Coleman in <em><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WPQRMeU4Co0" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">9 to 5,</a></em> a gross lech who repeatedly made unwanted sexual advances to female staffers and <a href="https://www.buzzfeednews.com/article/paulmcleod/she-complained-that-a-powerful-congressman-harassed-her#.dyqANaD2D" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">reportedly</a> retaliated against those who resisted. </p><p>Consensual sex is both natural and fun, but nonconsensual sex isn't a great pop song. I don't understand how we conflated the two. <em>My personal opinion</em> is that office romances are a bad idea but they're not inherently unethical or criminal. Yes, there are oppressive workplace environments where (mostly) women aren't empowered to say "no" to their supervisors. Brooke Nevils legitimately believed her career was at risk if she didn't continue a sexual relationship with former "Today" show host <a href="https://www.wonkette.com/matt-lauer-even-more-of-gross-rapist-asshole-than-we-thought" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Matt Lauer,</a> who she says raped her. Vanina Guerrero recently charged that Louis Lehot, co-managing partner at DLA Piper, assaulted her multiple times. He lied about the nature of their "relationship" and actively sabotaged her professionally. <a href="https://www.wonkette.com/frottage-perv-mark-halperin-demands-his-second-act-at-lousy-punditry" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Mark Halperin</a> and <a href="https://www.wonkette.com/louis-ck-is-ready-for-his-redemption-arc-mr-demille" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Louis C.K.</a> masturbated in front of horrified women because that's something disgusting but powerful men like to do.</p></div>
<div class="js-appear-on-expand">
<script type="keep-reading-content">&lt;p class=&#34;shortcode-media shortcode-media-youtube&#34;&gt;
        &lt;span style=&#34;display:block;position:relative;padding-top:56.25%;&#34; class=&#34;rm-shortcode&#34; data-rm-shortcode-id=&#34;UAE5WU1572120896&#34;&gt;&lt;iframe lazy-loadable=&#34;true&#34; src=&#34;https://www.youtube.com/embed/cF6CN042WVs?rel=0&#34; width=&#34;100%&#34; height=&#34;auto&#34; frameborder=&#34;0&#34; scrolling=&#34;no&#34; style=&#34;position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;&#34;&gt;&lt;/iframe&gt;&lt;/span&gt;
        &lt;small class=&#34;image-media media-caption&#34; placeholder=&#34;Add Photo Caption...&#34;&gt;Katie Hill: Opponent won&#39;t love being unseated by a millennial&lt;/small&gt;
        &lt;small class=&#34;image-media media-photo-credit&#34; placeholder=&#34;Add Photo Credit...&#34;&gt;
            &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cF6CN042WVs&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;www.youtube.com&lt;/a&gt;
        &lt;/small&gt;
        &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Hill is not like any of these men. I respect the opinion of those who believe sexual relationships with a subordinate are always wrong. And elected officials should have the will and ethical restraint to follow simple rules. But people make mistakes. Hill fooling around with a staffer during the fractious, final days of her marriage is a lapse in judgment. It should remain private. There&#39;s no evidence that she forced herself on the staffer or coerced her in any way. The relationship is just ... inappropriate, which seems like we&#39;re judging someone&#39;s personal choices without considering their actual impact on others. It just feels weird and regressive, like when you learn one of King Henry&#39;s wives was executed because she cheated on him.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;I&#39;m also wary of the argument that these relationships are wrong simply because society believes they&#39;re wrong so it makes a politician subject to blackmail because they&#39;re desperate to avoid exposure (whew!). This is the kind of circular logic that was used to discriminate against gay people in the not-so-good old days.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Even Republican Rep. &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/matt-gaetz-if-trump-did-thing-trump-confessed-to-thats-bad-but-trump-didnt-do-thing-trump-confessed-to-so&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Matt Gaetz&lt;/a&gt; agrees, which concerns me a little. But I guess this falls under the &#34;stopped clock&#34; principle.&lt;/p&gt;
        &lt;p class=&#34;shortcode-media shortcode-media-twitter_embed&#34;&gt;
        &lt;iframe width=&#34;100%&#34; height=&#34;150&#34; scrolling=&#34;no&#34; id=&#34;twitter-embed-1187338202266460165&#34; src=&#34;/res/community/twitter_embed/?iframe_id=twitter-embed-1187338202266460165&amp;created_ts=1571918461.0&amp;screen_name=mattgaetz&amp;text=This+is+just+absurd.+The+only+person+who+seems+to+have+a+gripe+is+%40RepKatieHill%E2%80%99s+soon-to-be+ex.+%0A%0AWho+among+us+wou%E2%80%A6+https%3A%2F%2Ft.co%2FaugRT71bCT&amp;id=1187338202266460165&amp;name=Matt+Gaetz&#34; frameborder=&#34;0&#34; class=&#34;rm-shortcode&#34; data-rm-shortcode-id=&#34;G7IIO01572034472&#34;&gt;&lt;/iframe&gt;
        &lt;/p&gt;
        &lt;p&gt;Hill&#39;s troubles began this weekend when Red State published a series of articles accusing Hill of an affair with her unnamed staff member and Kelly. It also ran a nude photo of Hill -- a gross violation of her privacy. Red State isn&#39;t a common &lt;em&gt;Penthouse&lt;/em&gt; magazine, which printed nude photos of &lt;a href=&#34;https://time.com/3961120/miss-america-scandal-vanessa-williams/&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Vanessa Williams&lt;/a&gt; in 1984. &lt;em&gt;Penthouse&lt;/em&gt; just wanted to cash in on the first black Miss America&#39;s sudden fame and didn&#39;t care if her life was ruined in the process. (Williams &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p1rJAFNFVEc&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;bounced the fuck back,&lt;/a&gt; by the way.) Red State is a publication with the journalistic ethics of a Peeping Tom that likes aiming wrecking balls at Democrats. Red State even ran some followup articles (nope, not linking them) expressing its annoyance that legitimate media hadn&#39;t hopped on the Katie Hill Smear Campaign bandwagon.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;The &lt;em&gt;Daily Mail,&lt;/em&gt; unfortunately, did jump on with all eight feet like a common &lt;em&gt;Hustler&lt;/em&gt;. The &lt;em&gt;Mail&lt;/em&gt; identified the female staffer without (as far as we know) her consent, which was gross and served no public good. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class=&#34;shortcode-media shortcode-media-rebelmouse-image&#34;&gt;
        &lt;img lazy-loadable=&#34;true&#34; src=&#34;https://assets.rebelmouse.io/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpbWFnZSI6Imh0dHBzOi8vYXNzZXRzLnJibC5tcy8yMjAzMTY2Ny9vcmlnaW4ucG5nIiwiZXhwaXJlc19hdCI6MTU3MjU2NzU4N30.61ToG6KiB1YGbEV0276zZGqYa5mNa7suLhDVCCcAhqc/img.png?width=980&#34; id=&#34;098f0&#34; class=&#34;rm-shortcode&#34; data-rm-shortcode-id=&#34;9CU7RC1572120896&#34; data-rm-shortcode-name=&#34;rebelmouse-image&#34;   /&gt;
        
        
        &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;What&#39;s &#34;shocking&#34; is that the &lt;em&gt;Mail&lt;/em&gt; would print someone&#39;s personal photos -- amateurishly obscuring the &#34;naughty bits&#34; with what looks like a Sharpie. Monica Lewinsky&#39;s life was steamrolled in 1998 but she was a witness in an independent counsel investigation. There&#39;s no reason to think that the female staffer would ever have to come forward publicly. Lewinksy also turned over the infamous dress. The staffer did not turn over these pictures. It&#39;s also not clear that Hill&#39;s tattoo is of the Iron Cross, and I&#39;ve already examined it longer than my wedding vows permit. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;The likely source for Hill&#39;s personal text messages and nude photos isn&#39;t anyone who works for her but probably her soon-to-be ex husband, who Hill claims was &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.refinery29.com/en-us/2019/10/8618541/katie-hill-revenge-porn-nude-photos-leaked-congress&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;&#34;abusive.&#34;&lt;/a&gt;  Years ago, an employee&#39;s jilted ex came to the office to personally tell me what he believed was incriminating information about her. There&#39;s nothing worse than trying to destroy a woman because she wants nothing more to do with your sorry ass. (I had a sudden bout of amnesia that day so immediately forgot everything the asshole told me.)&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Hill is standing firm and cooperating with the ethics investigation. She&#39;s apologized to her constituents in a public statement:&lt;/p&gt;&lt;blockquote&gt;&#34;During the final tumultuous years of my abusive marriage, I became involved in a relationship with someone on my campaign. I know that even a consensual relationship with a subordinate is inappropriate, but I still allowed it to happen despite my better judgment. For that I apologize. I wish nothing but the best for her and hope everyone respects her privacy in this difficult time.&#34;&lt;/blockquote&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;a href=&#34;https://www.nytimes.com/2019/10/22/us/politics/katie-hill-relationship.html&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Reportedly,&lt;/a&gt; some male Democrats privately believe Hill is the beneficiary of a double standard -- like all those lucky ducky women in the working world. They think a man in Hill&#39;s situation would&#39;ve immediately resigned by now. They must have trouble comprehending consent. Rep. &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.politico.com/story/2017/10/05/tim-murphy-abortion-scandal-office-staffers-243521&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Tim Murphy&lt;/a&gt; resigned in 2017 because he was outed as a creep who abused his staff. Rep. Joe Barton sent &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.thedailybeast.com/gop-rep-joe-barton-apologizes-after-graphic-photo-circulates-online&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;unsolicited&lt;/a&gt; dick picks. &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/rep-trent-franks-of-arizona-is-expected-to-resign/2017/12/07/479d156a-db9f-11e7-b859-fb0995360725_story.html&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Rep. Trent Franks&lt;/a&gt; asked female employees if they&#39;d consider bearing his children. Katie Hill had an affair. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Ideally, we would create workplace cultures where employees are free to report sexual misconduct without fear. But I don&#39;t think the solution is to remove employees&#39; freedom to choose their sexual partners. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;[&lt;a href=&#34;https://www.cnbc.com/2019/10/24/rep-katie-hill-admits-to-having-an-inappropriate-relationship-with-a-staffer.html&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;CNBC&lt;/a&gt;]&lt;br/&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Follow Stephen Robinson on &lt;/em&gt;&lt;em&gt;&lt;a href=&#34;https://twitter.com/SER1897&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Twitter.&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/em&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Yr Wonkette is supported by reader donations.     This Is Not America
</a></h1>
<div class="widget__subheadline">
<h2 class="widget__subheadline-text h2"><p>Bill Barr's clownshow Carmen Sandiego investigation of 'origins' of Russia probe is now a CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION. Welcome to Donald Trump's Kremlin shithole banana republic.</p></h2>
</div>
<div class="social-author clearfix">
<div class="social-author__avatar image">
<div class="cover-all image" style='background-image: url("https://assets.rbl.ms/18110596/210x.jpg")'></div>
</div>
<a class="social-author__name" href="https://www.wonkette.com/u/evan_hurst">Evan Hurst</a>
</div>
<div class="social-date">
<span class="social-date__text">October 25, 2019 12:33 PM</span>
</div>
<div class="body js-expandable clearfix js-listicle-body css-listicle-body-2641101862">
<div class="body-description"><div class="widget__brief"><p>The <em>New York Times</em> <a href="https://www.nytimes.com/2019/10/24/us/politics/john-durham-criminal-investigation.html" target="_blank">reported</a> Thursday night that Attorney General Bill Barr's <a href="https://www.wonkette.com/everything-you-never-wanted-to-know-about-bill-barrs-totally-real-global-carmen-sandiego-on-bath-salts-adventures" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">jaunt around the globe</a> to chase down every weird conspiracy theory about the origins of the Russia investigation that falls out of Donald Trump's ass is now a <em>criminal</em> investigation, which means John Durham, the US attorney ostensibly leading the investigation, now has power to impanel a grand jury, issue subpoenas, and yes, bring criminal charges.</p><p>Against people who investigated Russia's attack on the 2016 election that helped install Donald Trump in office. </p><p>If this news is what it seems like it is, then America is on thin ice. This is Kremlin shithole banana republic stuff, which shouldn't surprise us, because a Kremlin shithole banana republic guy is president of the United States.</p><p>So is Trump just going after his political enemies and using the strong arm of the Justice Department, led by Bill Barr, his low-rent frumpy Roy Cohn stand-in, to do it? Well, it would appear that way, wouldn't it! Think about it. Trump literally thinks the men and women who have conducted these investigations have committed <em>treason</em>.</p></div>
<div class="js-appear-on-expand">
<script type="keep-reading-content">&lt;p&gt;&lt;span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;Ever since the beginning of Trump&#39;s presidency, he has done everything he can to turn into Public Enemy No. 1 every single person involved with investigating whether or not he or his campaign conspired with our adversary Russia in its to project to steal an American election. He fired FBI Director James Comey. He&#39;s &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/strzok-strikes-back&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;led insane Twitter campaigns&lt;/a&gt; against Peter Strzok and Lisa Page, two FBI officials who were not only extra-maritally fucking, but who also are known for being experts in going after &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/peter-strzok-testimony-live-updates&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Russian spies&lt;/a&gt; and &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/lets-throw-a-bunch-of-sh-t-at-the-wall-and-call-it-the-trump-russia-smokinggun&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Russian organized crime,&lt;/a&gt; respectively. (Page&#39;s team in Budapest helped put together the bribery case against Ukrainian oligarch and alleged frontman for the Russian mob Dmitry Firtash, who is &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/rudy-giuliani-says-he-never-met-ukrainian-oligarch-dmitry-firtash-and-you-can-take-that-to-the-bank&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;suddenly a star&lt;/a&gt; of the Trump-Ukraine scandal, as he seemingly tried to trade fake dirt on Joe Biden for the Justice Department&#39;s help with the case the Chicago feds brought against him. Weird, right?)&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Another one of Trump&#39;s &lt;em&gt;bêtes noires&lt;/em&gt; is Bruce Ohr, who, big surprise, &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/who-the-fuck-is-bruce-ohr-a-wonksplanation-of-who-the-fuck-that-guy-is&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;is an expert&lt;/a&gt; on Russian organized crime and the Russian mob.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;And that&#39;s just scratching the surface of Americans Donald Trump despises. (We haven&#39;t mentioned Andrew McCabe, whom Trump and his Justice Department &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/justice-department-will-get-andy-mccabe-or-die-tryin&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;have been targeting&lt;/a&gt; for ages. Mentioning him right now!) &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Before last night&#39;s news, it had been reported that what began as a simple review has &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/justice-department/ag-barr-expands-controversial-review-origin-russia-investigation-n1068971&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;significantly expanded&lt;/a&gt; lately, with Durham&#39;s team wanting to interview former CIA director John Brennan (one of Trump&#39;s perceived biggest threats, with whom &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.politico.com/news/2019/10/22/trump-vengeance-john-brennan-russia-053970&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;he is &lt;em&gt;obsessed&lt;/em&gt;&lt;/a&gt; to the point he &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/aunt-lydia-announces-john-brennan-shall-be-punished&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;tried to take&lt;/a&gt; Brennan&#39;s security clearance away) and former director of national intelligence James Clapper (Trump hates him too). NBC News reported Durham&#39;s also been wanting to talk to CIA people &#34;involved in the intelligence assessment of Russia&#39;s activities,&#34; we guess just to find out if they&#39;ve been framing Russia this whole time like Donald Trump obviously believes. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&#34;All roads lead to Putin,&#34; just like &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/nancy-pelosi-blesses-trumps-heart-after-presidents-brain-leaks-all-over-white-house-floor-again&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Nancy Pelosi said.&lt;/a&gt; &lt;/p&gt;&lt;h2&gt;So What Supposedly &#39;Criminal&#39; Acts Might Barr And Durham Be Investigating?&lt;/h2&gt;&lt;p&gt;LOL who fuckin&#39; knows. We doubt Bill Barr or John Durham even knows. Quick, guys, make something up! According to the Justice Department manual, for a criminal investigation to be opened, &#34;there must be an objective, factual basis for initiating the investigation; a mere hunch is insufficient.&#34; But then again, this is the vile Trump-fellating Bill Barr Justice Department, so who knows if they&#39;re even looking at the manual anymore. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Maybe Durham is investigating whether Peter Strzok was &lt;em&gt;BIAAAASSSSSSSSS&lt;/em&gt; against Trump, which is obviously illegal under our new American laws, which say that if you hurt Donald Trump&#39;s feelings, you are a common no-gooder like Hillary Clinton and LOCK HER UP. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Of course they are obviously investigating whether it is against the law to do FISA surveillance on people the FBI &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/carter-page-fisa&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;has suspected&lt;/a&gt; of being Russian spies for YEARSFUCKINGYEARS, like Trump campaign useful idiot &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/why-the-hell-are-republicans-dying-on-this-hill-to-defend-carter-page&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Carter Page.&lt;/a&gt; &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Here&#39;s one for Trump&#39;s batshit Bible of conspiracy theories:&lt;/p&gt;&lt;blockquote&gt;Mr. Durham has also asked whether C.I.A. officials might have somehow tricked the F.B.I. into opening the Russia investigation.&lt;/blockquote&gt;&lt;p&gt;Yeah, you bet. Sounds like the CIA to us. &#34;Trick or treat smell my feet, FBI! Hahahaha, you are doing a Russia investigation now, TRICKED YOU!&#34;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;As the &lt;em&gt;Times&lt;/em&gt; notes, the FBI actually opened the investigation without info from the CIA, but whatever, Barr and Durham, you do your thing.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;The &lt;em&gt;Times&lt;/em&gt; reports that Barr and Durham haven&#39;t actually interviewed any of the key players yet, so they&#39;re obviously working really hard. Of course that&#39;s probably because they&#39;ve been super-busy &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/everything-you-never-wanted-to-know-about-bill-barrs-totally-real-global-carmen-sandiego-on-bath-salts-adventures&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;gallivanting around the globe&lt;/a&gt; to Italy and the UK to find out if Trump&#39;s debunked right-wing conspiracy theories about the origins of the Russia investigation have any merit. (SPOILER, they don&#39;t.) &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;a href=&#34;https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/justice-department/ag-barr-expands-controversial-review-origin-russia-investigation-n1068971&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;NBC News:&lt;/a&gt; &lt;/p&gt;&lt;blockquote&gt;Durham has been busy on other fronts. He traveled with Barr to the United Kingdom and Italy in an effort to examine the contributions of foreign countries to the Russia probe. A Justice Department spokeswoman said the list of countries being examined includes Ukraine, but she declined to say whether Durham is investigating &#34;corruption related to the DNC server,&#34; as [Mick] Mulvaney put it in his Thursday news conference. [...]&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;A Western intelligence official familiar with what Durham has been asking of foreign officials says his inquiries track closely with the questions raised about the Russia investigation in right-wing media.&lt;/blockquote&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;And what is that conspiracy theory? Well ... let&#39;s see here goes. They believe that ...&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;The Deep State and the Italian government did NO COLLUSION and sent a weirdo Maltese professor named &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/whatever-bill-barr-did-in-italy-for-trump-we-bet-it-was-sexxxy-like-ciao&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Joseph Mifsud&lt;/a&gt; to TRICK Trump campaign foreign policy adviser George Papadopoulos into thinking the Russians had dirty Hillary Clinton emails, thereby forcing Pap to get drunk and barf that intel all over an Australian diplomat, Alexander Downer, in London, at which point (AND ACCORDING TO THE PLAN!) Downer told the FBI what was going on, which gave the Deep State the fake reason it needed to do a witch hunt of Donald Trump, who is pure as the driven snow and NO COLLUSION, NO COLLUSION, YOU ARE THE COLLUSION. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Additionally, the Russians did not hack the DNC, the DNC hacked the DNC, something something SETH RICH, and then &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/is-trumps-ukraine-treason-sh-t-about-russian-sanctions-yeah-sure-why-wouldnt-it-be&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;buried the evidence in the backyard in Ukraine&lt;/a&gt; and all of this was done to make it &lt;em&gt;look like&lt;/em&gt; Russia was trying to help Trump, and the dastardly plot worked so well that Trump was elected president and Hillary Clinton is eating grapes in Chappaqua right now. (Well, not &lt;em&gt;right now&lt;/em&gt; right now, &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/elijah-cummings-funeral&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;she is at the Baltimore funeral&lt;/a&gt; of the deeply beloved Rep. For the record, Italian prime minister Giuseppe Conte &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.nytimes.com/2019/10/23/world/europe/italy-trump-conspiracy-conte.html?module=inline&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;reaffirmed&lt;/a&gt; this very week that &lt;del&gt;Bill Barr is huffing paint&lt;/del&gt; the Italian government had neither shit nor shinola to do with the origins of the Russia investigation, therefore Barr and Durham&#39;s dumbass LOL Carmen San Diego on Bath Salts adventure around the globe remains as batshit as it ever was.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;Barr has also said one thing Durham is trying to figure out is whether Trump is right &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/is-obamas-wire-tapp-the-end-of-donald-trump-maybe-a-holy-shit-yall-investigation-into-wtf&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;when he asserts&lt;/a&gt; that the Obama Deep State put secret ghosts in his underpants to spy on his campaign, which is a definite possibility if you are a fucking crazy person. OK, Barr didn&#39;t say it that way, but we all remember when he sat before Congress and literally &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/bill-barr-is-your-batsh-t-fox-news-watching-uncle-and-you-hate-him&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;said with his mouth,&lt;/a&gt; &#34;I think spying did occur, yes. I think spying did occur.&#34;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;Like we said, banana republic Russian shit. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;h2&gt;Funny How We&#39;re Learning Of This Right Now!&lt;/h2&gt;&lt;p&gt;Ain&#39;t it!&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Regardless of what the Justice Department is actually doing as it reportedly investigates &lt;em&gt;itself&lt;/em&gt; for supposed crimes against Donald Trump and his &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/is-trump-a-russian-asset-the-dumbest-idiot-ever-or-all-of-them-katie-spies-and-former-spies-weigh-in&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Russian handlers&lt;/a&gt; (allegedly), it&#39;s notable that we&#39;re learning about it right after after Trump &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/we-need-to-talk-more-about-the-deliverable-trump-wanted-from-ukraine&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;desperately extorted&lt;/a&gt; Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy to make an announcement on CNN that he&#39;s investigating Joe Biden and the &lt;em&gt;real&lt;/em&gt; (not real) story of the 2016 election. After that didn&#39;t work, because Trump got caught and is now being impeached, we learned this very week that Rudy Giuliani&#39;s Chucklefucks, right before they were arrested at Dulles, &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/does-rudy-need-a-lawyer-thats-a-tough-one&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;were on their way to Vienna&lt;/a&gt; to try to set up a Sean Hannity interview with &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/trump-doubles-down-shouts-hell-yes-i-f-cked-that-ukrainian-chicken-for-america&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;corrupt former Ukrainian prosecutor general&lt;/a&gt; Viktor Shokin, so that he could say some lies to Hannity about Joe Biden and the &lt;em&gt;real &lt;/em&gt;(not real) story of the 2016 election, because that is a thing Shokin &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/whatever-bill-barr-did-in-italy-for-trump-we-bet-it-was-sexxxy-like-ciao&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;has some thoughts about.&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Well hell, if Trump can&#39;t get it from Zelenskiy, and he can&#39;t get it from Shokin, then BY GOLLY GOD, he&#39;s going to get it from his banana republic Justice Department! So now, regardless of what&#39;s &lt;em&gt;really&lt;/em&gt; happening behind the scenes, Trump will scream from the mountaintops, or at least from the top of his golden toilet as he tweets and shits, that the Justice Department is finally going after the REAL criminals, i.e. the folks in the FBI and CIA who thought it was bad that Trump&#39;s best friend Putin was attacking American democracy to install his dumbass shitmouthed puppet Trump in the presidency.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Exactly what he&#39;s been wanting the news to talk about all along!&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;What we&#39;re saying is that we are pretty sure that this story was leaked by Trump people who wanted to change the subject from impeachment. (Here are &lt;a href=&#34;https://twitter.com/marcambinder/status/1187748374935756800&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;a couple&lt;/a&gt; of &lt;a href=&#34;https://twitter.com/normative/status/1187544440824651776?s=20&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;threads&lt;/a&gt; you should read about why this is &lt;em&gt;probably&lt;/em&gt; a very strategic leak from Trump&#39;s Justice Department.) &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Again, every one of these idiots&#39; batshit conspiracy theories -- Ukraine is the real collusion, the DNC buried its server in the backyard in Ukraine, George Papadopoulos was FRAAAAAMED, all of it -- has been thoroughly and entirely debunked, and people who believe in them will probably get their own section in the DSM-V before too long. Hell, Trump&#39;s own first Homeland Security adviser Tom Bossert &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/donald-trump/enough-trump-s-former-homeland-security-adviser-disturbed-ukraine-allegations-n1060051&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;affirmed recently&lt;/a&gt; that all this shit has been debunked, and that he&#39;s tired of it festering in Trump&#39;s brain.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Also to be clear, the fact that Russia attacked the 2016 election to help Donald Trump is not in question! It has been established as fact, by the US intelligence community, by the &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/bill-barr-drew-dicks-all-over-mueller-report-but-lets-liveblog-it-anyway&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Mueller Report,&lt;/a&gt; and by the Republican-led &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/senate-intel-finds-surprise-trump-got-a-big-boost-from-his-pal-putin&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Senate Intelligence Committee,&lt;/a&gt; which has stated loudly and clearly that Russia did it, and they did it for Trump.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;FACT.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class=&#34;shortcode-media shortcode-media-twitter_embed&#34;&gt;

        &lt;/p&gt;&lt;h2&gt;So How Bad Is This Really?&lt;br/&gt;&lt;/h2&gt;&lt;p&gt;It&#39;s bad. But there are a lot of open questions. For instance, what the fuck are Barr and Durham are really fuckin&#39; doing here?&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Former DOJ official and MSNBC analyst Chuck Rosenberg &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.msnbc.com/rachel-maddow/watch/barr-s-political-goals-eyed-in-criminal-review-of-russia-probe-72008261525&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;appeared on Maddow&lt;/a&gt; last night and said this story strikes a lot of &#34;discordant&#34; notes for him, because he (and many others you&#39;ll see on Twitter) has worked with Durham, respects Durham, and &lt;em&gt;likes&lt;/em&gt; Durham, who has led investigations like this before. If Barr wanted this clownshow to have the thinnest patina of legitimacy, he got it by appointing Durham for the task. (Of course, one thing Durham has a reputation for is being &lt;em&gt;slooooooooow&lt;/em&gt;, so this may be going on a very long time, which redounds to Trump&#39;s benefit in the 2020 election, because Trump can keep it as a live issue.)&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;So on one hand, if Durham were taking his job seriously and for real investigating Donald Trump&#39;s fever dreams (if only to eliminate them as suspects), then one way for him to definitively conclude there is no &#34;there&#34; there (because there&#39;s not) would be for him to impanel a grand jury and interview every witness and cross every T and dot every I, then finally say &#34;ALL FINISHED!&#34; and close his criminal investigation without producing any criminals. (He&#39;s &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.nytimes.com/2010/11/10/world/10tapes.html&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;done it before!&lt;/a&gt;)&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;That&#39;s the best-case scenario. All the other scenarios are very bad, because all the &#34;on the other hands&#34; we can think of involve Bill Barr turning the Justice Department into an AR-15 and committing a mass shooting attack against the United States Constitution. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;So ... who knows!&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Of course, we&#39;re not actually worried they&#39;re going to find something legitimate to discredit the Russia investigation. They would literally have to make something up, and everybody in America with two brain cells to rub together knows this is some banana republic bullshit and doesn&#39;t trust a goddamned word Bill Barr has to say about anything.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;So as Democratic Rep. Sean Patrick Maloney of New York, a member of the House Intelligence Committee, &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.msnbc.com/rachel-maddow/watch/trump-barr-push-specious-theory-against-backdrop-of-impeachment-72006725971&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;said last night&lt;/a&gt; on Maddow, &#34;BRIIIIIING IT.&#34; He did not add &lt;em&gt;FUUUUUUUUUUCK&lt;/em&gt; THESE CLOWNS, but we are pretty sure he was thinking it.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;We&#39;re not scared of the truth. They are.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Never forget that.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;[&lt;a href=&#34;https://www.nytimes.com/2019/10/24/us/politics/john-durham-criminal-investigation.html&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;New York Times&lt;/a&gt; / &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/justice-department/ag-barr-expands-controversial-review-origin-russia-investigation-n1068971&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;NBC News&lt;/a&gt;]&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;a href=&#34;https://talkingpointsmemo.com/edblog/barrs-excellent-adventure-1&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;&lt;/a&gt;Follow Evan Hurst on Twitter &lt;a href=&#34;http://twitter.com/evanhurst&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;RIGHT HERE, DO IT RIGHT HERE!&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Wonkette is fully funded by readers like YOU. <h1 class="widget__headline h1">
<a aria-label="NYT Op-Ed Just Asking: Where Have All The Cowboys Gone?" class="widget__headline-text custom-post-headline" href="https://www.wonkette.com/nyt-columnist-wants-to-know-where-have-all-the-cowboys-gone">
    NYT Op-Ed Just Asking: Where Have All The Cowboys Gone?
</a></h1>
<div class="widget__subheadline">
<h2 class="widget__subheadline-text h2"><p>Said op-ed not written by Paula Cole. </p></h2>
</div>
<div class="social-author clearfix">
<div class="social-author__avatar image">
<div class="cover-all image" style='background-image: url("https://assets.rbl.ms/17399306/210x.jpg")'></div>
</div>
<a class="social-author__name" href="https://www.wonkette.com/u/robyn_pennacchia">Robyn Pennacchia</a>
</div>
<div class="social-date">
<span class="social-date__text">October 25, 2019 11:36 AM</span>
</div>
<div class="body js-expandable clearfix js-listicle-body css-listicle-body-2641091991">
<div class="body-description"><div class="widget__brief"><p>This Wednesday, Matt Labash of The Daily Caller took to the pages of the <em>New York Times</em> to whine about the fact that no one is John Wayne anymore. Did he mean, by this, that there are not nearly enough racist men out there who dodged the draft themselves and then went on to be big ol' cheerleaders for extremely bad wars? Of course not. Dubya ain't dead yet. No, Labash was referring to how fabulously manly John Wayne was and lamenting the entirely mythic days when all of the men were John Wayne, or at least aspired to be John Wayne — and the role of a recent issue of <em>GQ</em> in pushing men even further from the John Wayne ideal.</p><blockquote>John Wayne, that repository of testosterone — now considered an illicit substance in many states — once played a character who said, "You have to be a man first, before you're a gentleman." Who knows what, exactly, he meant by it? It sounded like a fine thing to say, back when men were unabashed "men." Now, we have #MeToo, and toxic males, and even such a once man-friendly rag as Gentlemen's Quarterly (i.e., GQ), which has historically celebrated men, seems to be just sick about them, eager to atone for their Y chromosome.</blockquote><p>I would <em>love</em> to know more about how #MeToo is preventing men from being men. Does Matt Labash believe that it is somehow not OK to talk about the ways in which "traditional" notions of masculinity have perhaps led to a culture of sexual harassment and even sexual assault? That perhaps the idea that a man's masculinity is dependent on his ability to get women to sleep with him is bad and even, dare I say it, toxic? </p><p>But specifically, Labash is very upset about a recent issue of <em>GQ</em> that focused on something called "The New Masculinity." It is, Labash feels, a <em>bad</em> masculinity. And, he says, it is not the business of men's magazine editors "with soft hands" to be weighing in on masculinity, even if they are also men.</p></div>
<div class="js-appear-on-expand">
<script type="keep-reading-content">&lt;blockquote&gt;For those curious to see just how much American masculinity is shifting — at least at Condé Nast headquarters in Manhattan — the trouble starts on the cover, in which the singer Pharrell Williams sports a canary-yellow, high-fashion Moncler sleeping-bag-as-gown, looking like Cinderella going to the Dick&#39;s Sporting Goods ball. From there, &#34;The Glorious Now of Men in Makeup&#34; spread is little surprise, with lacquered-up boy-banders, models and influencers dispensing invaluable beauty pointers, such as Gen Z trans model Casil McArthur, who advises going with &#34;mascara and lip tint. If I want to be extra, I&#39;ll incorporate intense sparkles.&#34;&lt;/blockquote&gt;&lt;p&gt;Oh, the horror? I guess? The bad thing about this, supposedly, is that this kind of &#34;masculinity&#34; is a kind of masculinity that would not appeal to men who need supplies for fishing and/or tractors, and that it therefore condemns them in some way. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;blockquote&gt;It&#39;s difficult to envision the guys down at the tackle shop or Tractor Supply going in for sleeping-bag couture and hot makeup tips. But then, they&#39;re the Old Man, the kind of man the new masculinity seeks to leave behind. Maybe they haven&#39;t paraded around female job applicants with open kimono, à la Charlie Rose, or haven&#39;t traumatized female colleagues by subjecting them to pelvic pinball, à la Mark Halperin. But in GQ&#39;s eyes they&#39;re guilty of a more universal sin: They&#39;re still living as men undefined by non-men.&lt;/blockquote&gt;&lt;p&gt;If only &lt;em&gt;GQ&lt;/em&gt; would go back to their roots and start trying to appeal to the coveted bait and tractor demographic once more!&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class=&#34;shortcode-media shortcode-media-rebelmouse-image&#34;&gt;
&lt;img class=&#34;rm-shortcode&#34; data-rm-shortcode-id=&#34;WGA2LP1572105926&#34; data-rm-shortcode-name=&#34;rebelmouse-image&#34; id=&#34;b62d3&#34; lazy-loadable=&#34;true&#34; src=&#34;https://assets.rebelmouse.io/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpbWFnZSI6Imh0dHBzOi8vYXNzZXRzLnJibC5tcy8yMjAyOTUyOC9vcmlnaW4uanBnIiwiZXhwaXJlc19hdCI6MTU3MjQyNjk5Mn0.RgZMDnliqUhSEWY_M6OVm2zerZl8HXM-tG8b7mcc1hM/img.jpg?width=980&#34;/&gt;
&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Labash complains that only four of the people interviewed on what it means to be a man today are heterosexual cisgender men, that men like John Waters and Magic Johnson&#39;s cosmetics-embracing son were asked for their input, as well as several women, claiming that &lt;em&gt;Ms&lt;/em&gt;. or Jezebel would never do such a thing in reverse. He&#39;s right, but &lt;em&gt;GQ&lt;/em&gt; is not and has never been the male version of &lt;em&gt;Ms&lt;/em&gt;. or Jezebel. If anything, it&#39;s probably closer to a male version of &lt;em&gt;Cosmopolitan&lt;/em&gt;, which frequently (at least when I read it) solicits the opinions of men for the purpose of &#34;helping&#34; women figure out what they want, in general and in bed. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;By focusing this issue on how men might improve themselves and sort of learn to get with the program — the program being you don&#39;t have to be a jerk to be a &#34;man&#34; and in fact there are all different kinds of ways to be one, some of which can absolutely include sparkles if you like sparkles — Labash claims that they are ruining civilization, which is somehow dependent on men and women being &#34;opposites.&#34;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;He is not alone in his sentiments. It has become a popular sport these days for right-wing men (and women!) to wail and scream about how no one will let men be men anymore and how masculinity is dying and what have you. It is, they believe, a very urgent matter, and definitely an entirely recent concern. Oh, how they pine for the old days, &lt;em&gt;when goyls were goyls and men were men.&lt;/em&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;h3&gt;A (Brief) People&#39;s History Of Men Whining About Other Men Being Unmanly &lt;/h3&gt;&lt;p&gt;But this is nothing new. If there is anything that has remained constant throughout history, it is generations of men freaking out over how &lt;em&gt;unmanly&lt;/em&gt; the current generation of men is. In first century Rome, Seneca the Elder was out there talking about how all the &#34;the Youngers&#34; were slothful and bad at war. By the time &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.jstor.org/stable/24616489?seq=1#page_scan_tab_contents&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Caesar rolled around&lt;/a&gt; in the second century, the historiographer Plutarch was remarking upon how &#34;daintily&#34; he arranged his hair, and The Elder Curio, a famous orator, was giving speeches calling him &#34;every woman&#39;s man and every man&#39;s woman.&#34;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&#34;Where are the men in Spain?&#34; the Spanish priest &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.jstor.org/stable/10.1353/ren.0.0024?seq=1#page_scan_tab_contents&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Francisco de Leon&lt;/a&gt; wanted to know in 1635. &#34;What I see are effeminate men... I see men converted into women!&#34; &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;In 1771, a reader of &lt;a href=&#34;https://historyhustle.com/2500-years-of-people-complaining-about-the-younger-generation/&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Town and Country magazine&lt;/a&gt; wrote in to share his thoughts and feelings on the men of the day:&lt;/p&gt;&lt;blockquote&gt;Whither are the manly vigor and athletic appearance of our forefathers flown? Can these be their legitimate heirs? Surely, no; a race of effeminate, self-admiring, emaciated fribbles can never have descended in a direct line from the heroes of Potiers and Agincourt.&lt;/blockquote&gt;&lt;p&gt;Whither indeed!&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;In the 1800s, manly men were &lt;em&gt;very&lt;/em&gt; concerned about dandies. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class=&#34;shortcode-media shortcode-media-rebelmouse-image&#34;&gt;
&lt;img class=&#34;rm-shortcode&#34; data-rm-shortcode-id=&#34;4UTLVZ1572105926&#34; data-rm-shortcode-name=&#34;rebelmouse-image&#34; id=&#34;3b384&#34; lazy-loadable=&#34;true&#34; src=&#34;https://assets.rebelmouse.io/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpbWFnZSI6Imh0dHBzOi8vYXNzZXRzLnJibC5tcy8yMjAyOTM3Ny9vcmlnaW4uanBnIiwiZXhwaXJlc19hdCI6MTU3MjMyNzk3Mn0.XtNWsFGYqtzolOsycUzZKpt7f5DNToEVioqdp1DLQy8/img.jpg?width=980&#34;/&gt;
&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Also, while the Victorian Era produced its own weird standards of what masculinity entailed, American men thought those &lt;a href=&#34;https://books.google.com/books?id=1U0TBwAAQBAJ&amp;amp;pg=PT32&amp;amp;lpg=PT32&amp;amp;dq=victorian+men+effeminate&amp;amp;source=bl&amp;amp;ots=7FvTJ70BlU&amp;amp;sig=ACfU3U1ccBlvhnln-zumgdshuyCl-s2fWQ&amp;amp;hl=en&amp;amp;sa=X&amp;amp;ved=2ahUKEwjYgrnUtrXlAhVmTt8KHR2qBf44FBDoATADegQICRAB#v=onepage&amp;amp;q=victorian%20men%20effeminate&amp;amp;f=false&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Victorian dudes were total pansies&lt;/a&gt;. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;At the turn of the 20th century, people were very worried that all the men living and working in urban areas were coming down with a psychological disorder called &#34;neurasthenia,&#34; an anxiety brought on by not living their best manly lives out in the wilderness, or whatever. It was this fear that led the publishing and advertising industries to, in essence, &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.theatlantic.com/national/archive/2014/12/lumbersexuality-and-its-discontents/383563/&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;create the romantic myth&lt;/a&gt; of the manly lumberjack. It was this same fear that led to a prevalence of cowboy movies and the cowboy aesthetic and to Calvin Coolidge wearing leather chaps with &#34;CAL&#34; written on the sides. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;div class=&#34;rm-embed embed-media&#34;&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;a class=&#34;gie-single&#34; href=&#34;http://www.gettyimages.com/detail/3241273&#34; id=&#34;CNDBxBTHRP5B-KaT8M5BDA&#34; style=&#34;color:#a7a7a7;text-decoration:none;font-weight:normal !important;border:none;display:inline-block;&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Embed from Getty Images&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;script&gt;window.gie=window.gie||function(c){(gie.q=gie.q||[]).push(c)};gie(function(){gie.widgets.load({id:&#39;CNDBxBTHRP5B-KaT8M5BDA&#39;,sig:&#39;xUCYw1HKvseJjoHt7B0DvwLyEiDqtZ8c69iCQQRrupw=&#39;,w:&#39;394px&#39;,h:&#39;594px&#39;,items:&#39;3241273&#39;,caption: true ,tld:&#39;com&#39;,is360: false })});&lt;/script&gt;&lt;script async=&#34;&#34; charset=&#34;utf-8&#34; src=&#34;//embed-cdn.gettyimages.com/widgets.js&#34;&gt;&lt;/script&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;Following that, supposedly manly men panicked over dang foreigners like Rudolph Valentino and Ramón Novarro, the women who swooned over them, and the men who started slicking their hair back to look like them. Then they were upset about beatniks, and then they were upset about men in the &#39;60s with their long hair and whatnot, then they were mad at disco (though, to be fair, that was more for reasons of racism). &lt;br/&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;There has never, in all of history, been any consistent standard of masculinity or of what it means for a man to be a man. Labash can lament &lt;em&gt;GQ&lt;/em&gt; articles about men wearing makeup all he likes, but he should probably look at some pictures of French men in the 1700s before doing so. He probably thinks taking ballet classes would be &#34;unmanly,&#34; but during the Renaissance, all court ballet dancers were men and it was considered a &lt;em&gt;very&lt;/em&gt; manly thing to do. He clearly thinks that any kind of introspection on whether or not certain behaviors labeled as &#34;masculine&#34; could be harmful to men and society at large is a threat to men, but there have certainly been loads of men, throughout the centuries, writing about ethics and human behavior. &lt;em&gt;None of this is new.&lt;/em&gt; &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;As the Scottish philosopher and social commentator &lt;a href=&#34;https://books.google.com/books?id=wq9KAAAAcAAJ&amp;amp;pg=PA373&amp;amp;lpg=PA373&amp;amp;dq=The+old+ideal+of+Manhood+has+grown+obsolete,+and+the+new+is+still+invisible+to+us,+and+we+grope+after+it+in+darkness,+one+clutching+this+phantom,+another+that;+Werterism,+Byronism,+even+Brummelism,+each+has+its+day%22&amp;amp;source=bl&amp;amp;ots=Il3BDYwpAR&amp;amp;sig=ACfU3U3a6PZvMQ-uTH5e6N_iqHVeH7QkVA&amp;amp;hl=en&amp;amp;sa=X&amp;amp;ved=2ahUKEwi--dnm2bXlAhUpmuAKHYcDD18Q6AEwAnoECAgQAQ#v=onepage&amp;amp;q=The%20old%20ideal%20of%20Manhood%20has%20grown%20obsolete%2C%20and%20the%20new%20is%20still%20invisible%20to%20us%2C%20and%20we%20grope%20after%20it%20in%20darkness%2C%20one%20clutching%20this%20phantom%2C%20another%20that%3B%20Werterism%2C%20Byronism%2C%20even%20Brummelism%2C%20each%20has%20its%20day%22&amp;amp;f=false&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Thomas Carlyle wrote&lt;/a&gt; back in 1831:&lt;/p&gt;&lt;blockquote&gt;&#34;The old ideal of Manhood has grown obsolete, and the new is still invisible to us, and we grope after it in darkness, one clutching this phantom, another that; Werterism, Byronism, even Brummelism, each has its day&#34;&lt;/blockquote&gt;&lt;p&gt;As long as Matt Labash doesn&#39;t hurt anyone, I don&#39;t think anyone cares what kind of &#34;masculine&#34; he wants to be. He is free to measure his own masculinity by how well he fits in at a tractor store, if he wishes. No one is stopping him, or anyone else, from doing this. No one is forcing him to wear makeup or do anything else he doesn&#39;t want to do. But he doesn&#39;t get to begrudge anyone else their definition either.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;[&lt;a href=&#34;https://www.nytimes.com/2019/10/23/opinion/GQ-men-masculinity.html&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;New York Times&lt;/a&gt;]&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Wonkette is independent and fully funded by readers like you. Click below to tip us!&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;form class=&#34;donation-form&#34; method=&#34;post&#34; name=&#34;donation&#34;&gt;&lt;p class=&#34;subheadline&#34;&gt;How often would you like to donate?&lt;/p&gt;&lt;div class=&#34;form-row row--plan&#34;&gt;&lt;label class=&#34;plan-type__label&#34;&gt;&lt;input checked=&#34;&#34; class=&#34;plan-type&#34; name=&#34;plan_type&#34; required=&#34;&#34; type=&#34;radio&#34; value=&#34;once&#34;/&gt; Just once

<a class="widget__section js-load-brick-on-click" href="https://www.wonkette.com/impeachment">Impeachment</a>
<h1 class="widget__headline h1">
<a aria-label="Matt Gaetz And Meatball Have Stepping On Rakes Contest. The Rakes Win." class="widget__headline-text custom-post-headline" href="https://www.wonkette.com/matt-gaetz-if-trump-did-thing-trump-confessed-to-thats-bad-but-trump-didnt-do-thing-trump-confessed-to-so">
    Matt Gaetz And Meatball Have Stepping On Rakes Contest. The Rakes Win.
</a></h1>
<div class="widget__subheadline">
<h2 class="widget__subheadline-text h2"><p>Congratulations, rakes!</p></h2>
</div>
<div class="social-author clearfix">
<div class="social-author__avatar image">
<div class="cover-all image" style='background-image: url("https://assets.rbl.ms/18110596/210x.jpg")'></div>
</div>
<a class="social-author__name" href="https://www.wonkette.com/u/evan_hurst">Evan Hurst</a>
</div>
<div class="social-date">
<span class="social-date__text">October 25, 2019 10:20 AM</span>
</div>
<div class="body js-expandable clearfix js-listicle-body css-listicle-body-2641093269">
<div class="body-description"><div class="widget__brief"><p>Oh man, Matt Gaetz is having a hard time, y'all. Fresh off bringing <a href="https://www.wonkette.com/matt-gaetzs-moron-rebellion-leaves-mark-on-impeachment-inquiry-a-skidmark" target="_blank">all his House Freedom Caucus buddies</a> to a congressional SCIF so they could endanger national security and steal INPEACHMENT SEEKRITS! while farting in mason jars and snorting it just to prove Adam Schiff is not their real dad, Gaetz <a href="https://talkingpointsmemo.com/news/gaetz-holding-military-aid-for-political-favor-is-inappropriate-but-thats-not-what-trump-did" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">went on MSNBC</a> to say that he agrees that if Donald Trump committed the crimes Donald Trump has confessed to with Ukraine, that would be VERY BAD, but he doesn't think Donald Trump committed the crimes Donald Trump has confessed to, so SHUT UP, YOU GUYS, SHUT UP!</p><p>The question was about <a href="https://www.wonkette.com/bill-taylors-testimony-is-holy-sh-t-wow-and-trump-is-f" target="_blank">Ambassador Bill Taylor's testimony</a> before Congress, but Gaetz didn't want to talk about that because of how the process is RIGGED! Anchor Hallie Jackson did finally get him to agree that doing quid pro quos with Ukraine for election dirt in exchange for military aid would be VERY BAD, not that Trump did that, no he never!</p></div>
<div class="js-appear-on-expand">
<script type="keep-reading-content">&lt;p class=&#34;shortcode-media shortcode-media-twitter_embed&#34;&gt;

<h1 class="widget__headline h1">
<a aria-label="Let's Sit Quietly Together And Witness Elijah Cummings's Funeral" class="widget__headline-text custom-post-headline" href="https://www.wonkette.com/elijah-cummings-funeral">
    Let's Sit Quietly Together And Witness Elijah Cummings's Funeral
</a></h1>
<div class="widget__subheadline">
<h2 class="widget__subheadline-text h2"><p>A liveblog, maybe.</p></h2>
</div>
<div class="social-author clearfix">
<div class="social-author__avatar image">
<div class="cover-all image" style='background-image: url("https://assets.rbl.ms/18110113/210x.jpg")'></div>
</div>
<a class="social-author__name" href="https://www.wonkette.com/u/doktor_zoom">Doktor Zoom</a>
</div>
<div class="social-date">
<span class="social-date__text">October 25, 2019 09:47 AM</span>
</div>
<div class="body js-expandable clearfix js-listicle-body css-listicle-body-2641100319">
<div class="body-description"><div class="widget__brief"><p>The funeral for Elijah Cummings will be held today at the church he attended, Baltimore's New Psalmist Baptist Church, starting at 10:00 Eastern. The <a href="https://www.baltimoresun.com/politics/bs-md-pol-obama-cummings-funeral-20191024-h7n2yqflnjcfpl6dbl6lfx3g2u-story.html" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">speakers </a>will include Barack Obama, Bill and Hillary Clinton, Nancy Pelosi, and former congressman Kweisi Mfume, whose seat Cummings won in 1996 when Mfume became president of the NAACP. Cummings's widow, Maya Rockeymoore Cummings, will also speak; she's the chair of the Maryland Democratic Party. </p><p>Yr Wonkette has the Washington Post's livestream below; you can also view the services <a href="https://www.c-span.org/video/?465670-1/representative-elijah-cummings-funeral-baltimore" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">at CSPAN</a> starting at 10. </p></div>
<div class="js-appear-on-expand">
<script type="keep-reading-content">&lt;p&gt;&lt;br/&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class=&#34;shortcode-media shortcode-media-youtube&#34;&gt;
        &lt;span style=&#34;display:block;position:relative;padding-top:56.25%;&#34; class=&#34;rm-shortcode&#34; data-rm-shortcode-id=&#34;QMZTKC1572112224&#34;&gt;&lt;iframe lazy-loadable=&#34;true&#34; src=&#34;https://www.youtube.com/embed/5W-74Hp3GzE?rel=0&#34; width=&#34;100%&#34; height=&#34;auto&#34; frameborder=&#34;0&#34; scrolling=&#34;no&#34; style=&#34;position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;&#34;&gt;&lt;/iframe&gt;&lt;/span&gt;
        &lt;small class=&#34;image-media media-caption&#34; placeholder=&#34;Add Photo Caption...&#34;&gt;Watch live 10:00 a.m.: Rep. Elijah Cummings to be honored by Obama, Clinton at funeral&lt;/small&gt;
        &lt;small class=&#34;image-media media-photo-credit&#34; placeholder=&#34;Add Photo Credit...&#34;&gt;
            &lt;a href=&#34;https://youtu.be/5W-74Hp3GzE&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;youtu.be&lt;/a&gt;
        &lt;/small&gt;
        &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;br/&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Cummings, a fighter&lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/elijah-cummings-1951-2019&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt; for civil rights and basic decency,&lt;/a&gt; died last Thursday in hospice care in Baltimore, at the age of 68. He hadn&#39;t been in Congress for a roll call vote since September, but continued with committee work right up until the end, &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.wonkette.com/cummings-goes-out-swinging&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;sending out subpoenas&lt;/a&gt; just hours before he passed away. &lt;br/&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Elijah Cummings&#39;s prominence as an opponent of Donald Trump&#39;s racism, inhuman border policies, and abuses of office made him a target for abuse by the &#34;president&#34; and his online troll army. Expect the Usual Suspects to pretend they&#39;re shocked and horrified by any statements at the memorial that might be deemed to &#34;politicize&#34; the services for a man who used political office to do good. There&#39;s already been some tut-tutting (and some &lt;em&gt;very unseemly&lt;/em&gt; celebration) of a pallbearer&#39;s passing over Mitch McConnell and Kevin McCarthy while shaking hands with lawmakers at the Capitol yesterday. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class=&#34;shortcode-media shortcode-media-twitter_embed&#34;&gt;
        &lt;iframe width=&#34;100%&#34; height=&#34;150&#34; scrolling=&#34;no&#34; id=&#34;twitter-embed-1187403541113126915&#34; src=&#34;/res/community/twitter_embed/?iframe_id=twitter-embed-1187403541113126915&amp;created_ts=1571934039.0&amp;screen_name=akajd31&amp;text=I+think+this+brother+right+here+walked+right+past+McConnell+and+did+NOT+shake+his+hand%21%21%21++Wow%21++%40DrJasonJohnson%E2%80%A6+https%3A%2F%2Ft.co%2F56f5zOvDrp&amp;id=1187403541113126915&amp;name=Moni+jay&#34; frameborder=&#34;0&#34; class=&#34;rm-shortcode&#34; data-rm-shortcode-id=&#34;7D8UO41572025560&#34;&gt;&lt;/iframe&gt;
        &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;For our money, there&#39;s no better discussion of the rampant bad faith in condemning &#34;politics&#34; at a politician&#39;s memorial than the chapter on the 2002 celebration of Sen. Paul Wellstone&#39;s life, in Al Franken&#39;s book &lt;a href=&#34;https://amzn.to/2Phm36E&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;Lies: And the Lying Liars who Tell Them&lt;/a&gt;.  (A 2001 recap by Franken &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.huffpost.com/entry/reflections-on-the-wellst_b_15459&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer&#34; target=&#34;_blank&#34;&gt;can be found here&lt;/a&gt;). Minnesotans loved Wellstone, and a couple of speakers at the memorial went beyond remembering his dedication to fighting the good fight, calling on Minnesotans to win the upcoming election &#34;for Paul.&#34; Some people in the crowd -- not the entire stadium -- booed Republican Trent Lott. But that was enough for very sensitive folks on the right, like etiquette expert Rush Limbaugh who hadn&#39;t actually watched the event, to gripe that the service had been &lt;em&gt;undignified&lt;/em&gt; and a &lt;em&gt;great shame,&lt;/em&gt; and then to start lying endlessly about how the entire service was a political rally with a &#34;planted&#34; partisan crowd, where those terrible liberals trashed George Bush and America all day.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Update: &lt;/strong&gt;As it happens, today is the anniversary of the plane crash that killed Wellstone, his wife Shiela, and their daughter Marcia, as well as the two pilots and two of Wellstone&#39;s campaign aides. &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class=&#34;shortcode-media shortcode-media-twitter_embed&#34;&gt;
        &lt;iframe width=&#34;100%&#34; height=&#34;150&#34; scrolling=&#34;no&#34; id=&#34;twitter-embed-1187716092120256513&#34; src=&#34;/res/community/twitter_embed/?iframe_id=twitter-embed-1187716092120256513&amp;created_ts=1572008557.0&amp;screen_name=amyklobuchar&amp;text=Today+marks+17+years+since+we+tragically+lost+Paul+Wellstone%2C+his+wife+Sheila%2C+daughter+Marcia%2C+and+staff+Tom%2C+Mary%E2%80%A6+https%3A%2F%2Ft.co%2FQIj318DaSf&amp;id=1187716092120256513&amp;name=Amy+Klobuchar&#34; frameborder=&#34;0&#34; class=&#34;rm-shortcode&#34; data-rm-shortcode-id=&#34;JBDR8C1572025561&#34;&gt;&lt;/iframe&gt;
        &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Today&#39;s memorial will be in a church, not a football stadium, but the rightwing Civility Police have become ever more watchful, and we don&#39;t doubt for a moment that if any of the speakers so much as mentions anything &#34;political,&#34; however obliquely, the sound of pearls being clutched will be deafening. What if Barack Obama mentions his own family, like the narcissist he is? Or if Hillary Clinton talks too sharply about Cummings&#39;s basic decency?   if (!Element.prototype.matches)
      Element.prototype.matches = Element.prototype.msMatchesSelector || 
                                  Element.prototype.webkitMatchesSelector;
  
  if (!Element.prototype.closest)
      Element.prototype.closest = function(s) {
          var el = this;
          if (!document.documentElement.contains(el)) return null;
          do {
              if (el.matches(s)) return el;
              el = el.parentElement || el.parentNode;
          } while (el !== null && el.nodeType === 1); 
          return null;
  };
  
  function formsHandling() {
    var formDonate = document.querySelectorAll('.donation-form:not(.processed)');

    formDonate.forEach(function(formEl) {
      var formEl = formEl;

      formEl.classList.add("processed");

      formEl.addEventListener("submit", function(event) { 
        event.preventDefault(); 
      });


      var donationBtns = formEl.querySelectorAll('.donate-button');

      donationBtns.forEach(function(el) {
        el.addEventListener("click", function(event) {
          event.preventDefault(); 
          formProcessing(el)
        });
      });

      function formProcessing(el) {
        var btn = el;
        var payment = btn.getAttribute('data-payment');
        var planType = formEl.querySelector('input[name="plan_type"]:checked').value;
        var checkedOption = formEl.querySelector('input[name="amount"]:checked');
        var amount = checkedOption.value * 1;
        var amountOptional = checkedOption.getAttribute('data-amount');
        var dataValue = checkedOption.getAttribute('data-value');
        var action;

        if ( formEl.contains(formEl.querySelector('.remove-me')) ) {
          formEl.querySelectorAll('.remove-me').forEach(function(el){ 
            el.remove() 
          });
        }

        if ( payment == "paypal" ) {
          formEl.action = "https://www.paypal.com/cgi-bin/webscr";
          formEl.setAttribute('target', '_blank');

          addHidden( 'currency_code', 'USD');
          addHidden( 'cmd', '');
          addHidden( 'return', "https://www.wonkette.com/st/Wonkettes_Hero");
          addHidden( 'cancel_return', window.location.href);

          if ( planType == "once" ) {
            checkedOption.value = dataValue;
            formEl.querySelector('input[name="cmd"]').value = '_donations';
            addHidden( 'business', 'rebecca@wonkette.com');
            addHidden( 'item_name', 'Wonkette Donation');
            addHidden( 'item_number', 'Just Once');

            //add new params
            addHidden( 'a3', dataValue);
            addHidden( 'p3', 1);
            addHidden( 't3', 'D');

          } else if ( planType == "monthly" ) {
            formEl.querySelector('input[name="cmd"]').value = '_xclick-subscriptions';
            addHidden( 'business', 'rebecca@wonkette.com');
            addHidden( 'item_name', 'Wonkette Recurring Donation');
            addHidden( 'item_number', 'wonkette_recurring');

            //add new params
            addHidden( 'a3', dataValue);
            addHidden( 'p3', 1);
            addHidden( 't3', 'M');
            addHidden( 'src', 1);
            addHidden( 'srt', 52);
          }
          formEl.submit();
        } else if ( payment == "strip" ) {
          addHidden( 'entity_type', 1);
          addHidden( 'plan_type', 1);
          addHidden('entity_id', getSiteId() );
          checkedOption.value = dataValue * 100;

          if ( planType == "once" ) {
            formEl.action = "/core/payment/single_donation";
            addHidden( 'plan_name', 'One Time Donation');
            stripInit(amount, 'One Time Donation');

          } else if ( planType == "monthly" ) {
            formEl.action = "/core/payment/recurring_donation";
            addHidden( 'plan_name', 'Monthly Donation');
            addHidden( 'plan', 'donation_' + amount);
            stripInit(amount, 'Monthly Donation');
          }

        }

      }
      function addHidden(key, value) {
        // Create a hidden input element, and append it to the form:
        var input = document.createElement('input');
        input.type = 'hidden';
        input.name = key;
        input.value = value;

          });

        }

    });
      
    function getSiteId() {
      var site_id = null;
      var inner = document.querySelector('html').innerHTML
      var str = inner.split('"site_id": ');
      if( str[1] != undefined ){
        site_id = str[1].split(',')[0];
      }
      return !isNaN(site_id) ? site_id : false;
    }
  }

  function keepReadingHandling() {
    let keepReading = document.querySelectorAll('.show-more.js-expand:not(.processed)');

    keepReading.forEach(function(el) {
      el.classList.add("processed");
      el.addEventListener("click", function() {
        setTimeout(formsHandling, 500)
      });
    });
    
  }
  
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function() {
    
    formsHandling();
    keepReadingHandling();
    
  });
